sec: 4.1 Basic Components of a Web Page

cards.t: Three components of a web page: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
cards.en:
Analogy: think of a house. HTML is the walls and rooms (what is there). CSS is the paint and furniture (how it looks). JavaScript is the electricity: lights that switch on when you press a button (what it does).

How it works: a website is a collection of web pages. Each page uses three technologies:

  • HTML (HyperText Markup Language): tags that mark headings, paragraphs, tables, images and links.
  • CSS (Cascading Style Sheet): rules for colour, font and layout.
  • JavaScript: a programming language inside the page that reacts to the user (clicks, typing).
If the exam asks about…Answer
structure / contentHTML
appearance / styleCSS
behaviour / interactionJavaScript

Exam wording: HTML uses markups (tags) to describe the structure and content of a web page. CSS describes the appearance/style of HTML elements. JavaScript is a programming language embedded in HTML that adds dynamic and interactive functions.
cards.zh:
比喻：网页像一间屋。HTML 是墙和房间（有什么），CSS 是油漆和家具（看起来怎样），JavaScript 是电力：按开关灯就亮（会做什么）。

原理：网站由多个网页组成，每页由三种技术合作：

  • HTML：用标签（tags）标出标题、段落、表格、图片、超连结。
  • CSS：规定颜色、字体、版面。
  • JavaScript：嵌在网页里的编程语言，回应用户的点击、输入。

口诀：结构 → HTML；外观 → CSS；互动 → JavaScript。

考试写法：HTML uses markups (tags) to describe the structure and content of a web page. CSS describes the appearance/style of HTML elements. JavaScript is a programming language embedded in HTML that adds dynamic and interactive functions.

ex.q: A page has a menu that opens when clicked, blue Arial headings, and a list of products. Which technology handles each feature?
ex.a:
1. Menu opens on click → something happens → JavaScript.
2. Blue Arial headings → how it looks → CSS.
3. List of products → content/structure → HTML (<ul>, <li>).
ex.az:
1. 点击展开 = 互动 → JavaScript。
2. 蓝色 Arial = 外观 → CSS。
3. 产品清单 = 结构 → HTML。

ex.q: In the live demo, which line makes the button do something?
ex.a:
1. The HTML line creates the button and the <p>.
2. The CSS rule makes the heading navy.
3. The JavaScript onclick function changes the text of <p> → this is the behaviour.
ex.az:
1. HTML 建立按钮和段落。
2. CSS 把标题变深蓝。
3. JavaScript 的 onclick 改变段落文字 → 这是行为。

ex.q: A student writes: 'CSS makes the button count how many times it is clicked.' Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake. CSS only changes appearance; it cannot count or store values.
1. Counting needs a variable and code → JavaScript.
2. CSS can only, e.g., change the button colour.
ex.az: 常见错误。CSS 只管外观，不能计数。计数需要变量和程序 → JavaScript。CSS 只能改按钮颜色等。

notes.t: HTML button; onclick runs the JavaScript function sayHi when clicked

cards.t: HTML is a markup language, not a programming language
cards.tz: HTML 是标记语言，不是编程语言
cards.en:
Analogy: a teacher marks an essay with a highlighter: 'this is the title', 'this is a quote'. The highlighter does not calculate anything; it only labels. HTML tags are labels like that.

How it works:

  • Markup = labels (tags) put around content, e.g. <h1>Title</h1>.
  • HTML has no variables, no loops, no if-decisions, so it is not a programming language.
  • It is plain text and a standard, so the same file opens in browsers on Windows, macOS, Android and iOS: it is cross-platform.
  • Hypertext = text with links to other documents.

Exam wording: Hypertext Markup Language (HTML) is a standard markup language used to write web pages. It is not a programming language but a cross-platform language used to define the elements in a web page.
cards.zh:
比喻：老师用荧光笔在作文上标「这是标题」「这是引文」。荧光笔不会计算，只是贴标签。HTML 的标签就是这样。

  • Markup（标记）：在内容两边加标签，例如 <h1>Title</h1>。
  • HTML 没有变量、循环、判断，所以不是编程语言。
  • 它是纯文字标准格式，不同系统的浏览器都能打开 → cross-platform（跨平台）。
  • Hypertext（超文本）：含有连到其他文件的连结的文字。

考试写法：HTML is a standard markup language used to write web pages. It is not a programming language but a cross-platform language used to define the elements in a web page.

ex.q: 'HTML is a programming language because it can display a table.' Is this correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Displaying a table is just labelling content (<table>, <tr>, <td>).
2. A programming language needs variables, selection (if) and loops; HTML has none.
3. So HTML is a markup language, not a programming language.
ex.az: 常见错误。显示表格只是给内容贴标签；编程语言要有变量、if、循环，HTML 都没有，所以是标记语言。

ex.q: Why can the same .html file be opened on an iPad and a Windows PC?
ex.a:
1. HTML is plain text following a common standard.
2. Every browser on every OS understands the standard.
3. So HTML is cross-platform.
ex.az:
1. HTML 是遵循统一标准的纯文字。
2. 各系统的浏览器都看得懂。
3. 所以跨平台。

ex.q: What does the 'Hypertext' in HTML mean? Give an example tag.
ex.a:
1. Hypertext = text containing links to other documents.
2. Example: <a href="news.html">News</a> — clicking 'News' opens another page.
ex.az:
1. 超文本 = 含连结的文字。
2. 例如 <a href="news.html">News</a>，点击就跳到另一页。

cards.t: CSS and why it is useful
cards.en:
Analogy: a school uniform rule says 'all shirts are white'. You change the rule once and every student follows it. A CSS rule works the same way for every matching element on every page.

How it works:

  • A CSS rule = selector (which elements) + property:value pairs (what to change). Example: h1 { color: navy; } means 'all h1 headings are navy'.
  • A shared style sheet (a .css file) can be linked by many pages.
  • In this chapter we mostly use the style attribute (inline CSS) on one element: <p style="color:blue">.

Exam wording: Cascading Style Sheet (CSS) is used to describe the style of HTML elements. A style can be applied to different pages of the website at the same time without setting them one by one, making the website easier and more efficient to create and maintain.
cards.zh:
比喻：校规写「所有衬衫是白色」，改一次规定，全校都跟。CSS 规则也一样，所有页面里符合的元素都会跟着变。

  • CSS 规则 = selector（选择器） + property:value（属性:值）。例：h1 { color: navy; } = 所有 h1 变深蓝。
  • 多个网页可共用同一个 .css 样式表。
  • 本章多用 style 属性（inline CSS），只影响一个元素：<p style="color:blue">。

考试写法：CSS is used to describe the style of HTML elements. A style can be applied to different pages at the same time without setting them one by one, making the website easier and more efficient to create and maintain.

ex.q: A school site has 40 pages. All headings must change from black to dark green. Why is a shared CSS file better than editing each page?
ex.a:
1. Put h1 { color: darkgreen; } in one style sheet linked by all 40 pages.
2. Change one line → all 40 pages update.
3. Saves time, keeps the style consistent, fewer mistakes.
ex.az:
1. 在共用样式表写一条规则。
2. 改一行，40 页同时更新。
3. 省时、风格一致、少出错。

ex.q: Write an inline style to make one paragraph red and 20px.
ex.a:
1. Use the style attribute in the start tag.
2. Separate properties with a semicolon:
<p style="color:red; font-size:20px">Sale!</p>
ex.az: 在开始标签加 style，属性之间用分号分隔：<p style="color:red; font-size:20px">。

ex.q: A student writes <p style="color=red">. Why does nothing change?
ex.a:
Common mistake. CSS uses a colon between property and value, not '='.
Correct: style="color:red". (The '=' is only used for the HTML attribute itself: style="…".)
ex.az: 常见错误。CSS 的属性和值之间用冒号 :，不是 =。正确：style="color:red"。

notes.t: Selector h1: the rule applies to every h1 element
notes.tz: 选择器 h1：规则套用到所有 h1

notes.t: Property color, value darkgreen: text colour
notes.tz: 属性 color，值 darkgreen：文字颜色

notes.t: Property font-family: use the Arial typeface
notes.tz: 属性 font-family：用 Arial 字体

cards.en:
Analogy: a new edition of a dictionary adds new words and removes old ones nobody should use any more. HTML5 is the 5th edition of HTML.

How it works:

  • Added: meaningful (semantic) elements that say what a part is: <header>, <footer>, <section>, <nav>; and built-in <audio>, <video>.
  • Removed: tags that only changed appearance: <center>, <font>, <frame>. Their jobs are now done by CSS (and <iframe>).
  • Idea: HTML for structure, CSS for look.

Exam wording: HTML5 added new semantic elements and attributes such as <header>, <footer> and <section>. Elements that only change appearance, such as <center>, <font> and <frame>, were removed and replaced by CSS.
cards.zh:
比喻：字典出新版，会加新词，也删掉不该再用的旧词。HTML5 就是 HTML 第五版。

  • 新增：有意义的语义元素 <header>、<footer>、<section>、<nav>，以及 <audio>、<video>。
  • 删除：只管外观的 <center>、<font>、<frame>，改用 CSS（和 <iframe>）。
  • 原则：HTML 管结构，CSS 管外观。

考试写法：HTML5 added new semantic elements such as <header>, <footer> and <section>. Elements that only change appearance, such as <center>, <font> and <frame>, were removed and replaced by CSS.

ex.q: Rewrite <center>Hi</center> in HTML5 style.
ex.a:
1. <center> was removed in HTML5.
2. Use CSS text-align instead:
<p style="text-align:center">Hi</p>
ex.az: <center> 已删除，改用 CSS：<p style="text-align:center">Hi</p>。

ex.q: Rewrite <font color="red" face="Arial">Sale</font> in HTML5 style.
ex.a:
1. <font> was removed.
2. Move colour and typeface to CSS:
<span style="color:red; font-family:Arial">Sale</span>
ex.az: <font> 已删除，把颜色和字体搬到 CSS：<span style="color:red; font-family:Arial">。

ex.q: A student says '<header> makes text bigger, like <h1>.' Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. <header> is a semantic element: it says 'this area is the top part of the page'.
2. It does not change size by itself; it can contain an <h1>, a logo and a nav bar.
3. Size is set by <h1> or CSS.
ex.az: 常见错误。<header> 是语义元素，表示「这是页面顶部区域」，本身不放大文字；可以包住 h1、logo、导航栏。

cards.t: How a browser gets a web page (HTTP)
cards.en:
Analogy: ordering at a counter. You (the client, your browser) say 'one burger please' (request). The kitchen (the web server) answers 'here you are' or 'sold out' (response with a status code).

How it works:

  1. The browser sends an HTTP request, e.g. GET /index.html.
  2. The server sends an HTTP response: a status line (e.g. 200 OK), headers (e.g. Content-Type: text/html), then the HTML file.
  3. The browser reads the HTML, requests extra files it needs (CSS, images, scripts), then renders (draws) the page.
StatusMeaning
200OK, file sent
404Not Found

Exam wording: The client (browser) sends an HTTP request to the web server; the server returns an HTTP response with a status code and the HTML file; the browser interprets the HTML and displays the web page.
cards.zh:
比喻：在柜台点餐。你（client，浏览器）说「一个汉堡」（request），厨房（web server）回答「给你」或「卖完了」（response 加状态码）。

  1. 浏览器发出 HTTP request，例如 GET /index.html。
  2. 服务器回 HTTP response：状态（200 OK）、标头（Content-Type: text/html），然后是 HTML 文件。
  3. 浏览器解读 HTML，再请求 CSS、图片等，最后显示网页。

200 = 成功；404 = 找不到。

考试写法：The client sends an HTTP request to the web server; the server returns an HTTP response with a status code and the HTML file; the browser interprets the HTML and displays the web page.

ex.q: A user requests /about.html but the file was deleted. What status does the response contain?
ex.a:
1. The server cannot find the file.
2. It returns 404 Not Found.
3. The browser shows an error page instead of the content.
ex.az: 文件不存在 → 服务器回 404 Not Found，浏览器显示错误页。

ex.q: index.html contains one <img> and links one style.css. How many HTTP requests does the browser make (ignore caching)?
ex.a:
1. Request 1: index.html.
2. Reading the HTML, it finds style.css → request 2.
3. It finds the image → request 3.
Total: 3 requests.
ex.az:
1. 先取 index.html。
2. 发现 style.css，再请求。
3. 发现图片，再请求。共 3 次。

ex.q: A student says 'the web server draws the page and sends a picture of it to the browser.' Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. The server sends the HTML text file (plus CSS/images when asked).
2. The browser interprets the HTML and renders the page on the client side.
ex.az: 常见错误。服务器只传送 HTML 文字文件（和 CSS、图片），由浏览器解读并显示网页。

demo.title: Loading a web page with HTTP

frames.en: The browser sends GET /index.html to the web server.
frames.zh: 浏览器向服务器发送 GET /index.html。

frames.en: The server finds the file and replies 200 OK, Content-Type: text/html, then the HTML.
frames.zh: 服务器找到文件，回 200 OK 和 HTML 内容。

frames.en: The browser reads the HTML and requests style.css and images too.
frames.zh: 浏览器读 HTML，再请求 style.css 和图片。

frames.en: The browser interprets everything and draws the page on screen.
frames.zh: 浏览器解读所有内容，在屏幕上显示网页。

frames.en: The server replies 404 Not Found.
frames.zh: 文件不存在时，服务器回 404 Not Found。

cards.t: HTML editors: text editor vs web authoring tool
cards.tz: HTML 编辑器：文字编辑器与网页制作工具
cards.en:
Analogy: writing a letter by hand (text editor: you control every word) versus using a greeting-card app (authoring tool: drag pictures, the app writes it for you).

Text editor (e.g. Notepad)Web authoring tool (e.g. Dreamweaver, Wix)
ProsFound in all operating systems; free; HTML code is concise; full controlWYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get): see the result while editing; no need to know HTML; drag-and-drop
ConsMust know HTML; no live previewGenerated code can be long and messy; may cost money

Saving: use the extension .html or .htm, then open the file in a browser. If saved as .txt, the browser shows the raw tags.

Exam wording: A text editor is available in all operating systems and produces concise HTML code. A web authoring tool is WYSIWYG, so users can design pages without knowing HTML.
cards.zh:
比喻：手写信（文字编辑器：每个字自己控制）对比贺卡 App（网页制作工具：拖放图片，App 帮你写）。

  • 文字编辑器（Notepad）：所有操作系统都有、免费、代码简洁；但要懂 HTML、没有即时预览。
  • 网页制作工具（Dreamweaver、Wix）：WYSIWYG（所见即所得）、不用懂 HTML、可拖放；但生成的代码较长较乱、可能收费。

储存时扩展名用 .html 或 .htm，再用浏览器打开。

考试写法：A text editor is available in all operating systems and produces concise HTML code. A web authoring tool is WYSIWYG, so users can design pages without knowing HTML.

ex.q: Tom saves his page as 'home.txt' and double-clicks it. He sees raw tags. Fix it.
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. A .txt file is treated as plain text, so the tags are shown, not interpreted.
2. Rename/save it as home.html (or .htm).
3. Open it with a browser.
ex.az: 常见错误。.txt 被当成纯文字，所以显示标签。改存为 home.html，再用浏览器打开。

ex.q: Give one advantage of each tool for a beginner who knows no HTML, and for an expert.
ex.a:
1. Beginner → authoring tool: WYSIWYG, drag-and-drop, no HTML needed.
2. Expert → text editor: concise code, full control, free on every OS.
ex.az:
1. 初学者：网页制作工具，所见即所得，不用懂 HTML。
2. 专家：文字编辑器，代码简洁，完全控制。

ex.q: What does WYSIWYG stand for and what does it mean?
ex.a:
1. What You See Is What You Get.
2. While designing, the screen already looks like the final web page, so you see changes immediately.
ex.az: 所见即所得：编辑时画面已和最终网页一样，修改立即看到。

cards.t: Viewing source code, online previewers and drag-and-drop builders
cards.tz: 查看源代码、在线预览器与拖放式建站工具
cards.en:
Plain idea: every page you visit is HTML. You can open it and look inside, try code online without installing anything, or skip code completely with a drag-and-drop builder.

  • View source (Lab 4.1): in Chrome, Menu → More Tools → Developer Tools (or right-click → Inspect). Hovering over a line of HTML highlights that element on the page.
  • Online HTML editors / real-time previewers: type code and see the result instantly, no software to install.
  • Drag-and-drop web design tools (e.g. Google Sites, Wix, Weebly): the easiest kind of authoring tool; build pages by dragging components, no programming knowledge needed, so suitable for non-technical users.
  • Text editors in the book: Microsoft Notepad, Notepad++. Web authoring tools: NetBeans, Visual Studio, Dreamweaver (templates, auto-indentation, syntax highlighting, auto-completion, testing and debugging).

Exam wording: Inspecting a web page in the browser shows HTML code such as <html>, <body> and <img src="...">, not program statements like print().
cards.zh:
简单说：你浏览的每个网页都是 HTML。可以打开来看源代码、在网上即时试代码，或用拖放工具完全不写代码。

  • 查看源代码（Lab 4.1）：Chrome 选单 → More Tools → Developer Tools（或右键 → Inspect）。鼠标移到某行 HTML，页面上对应元件会被标示。
  • 在线 HTML 编辑器／即时预览：输入代码立即看到结果，不用安装软件。
  • 拖放式网页设计工具（如 Google Sites、Wix、Weebly）：最易用，拖拉组件即可，不需编程知识，适合非技术用户。
  • 课本的文字编辑器：Notepad、Notepad++；网页编写工具：NetBeans、Visual Studio、Dreamweaver（范本、自动缩排、语法高亮、自动完成、测试除错）。

考试写法：Inspecting a web page in the browser shows HTML code such as <html>, <body> and <img src="...">, not program statements like print().

ex.q: Eric uses 'Inspect' on a page showing text and an emoji picture. Which would he see: print("Delicious") or Delicious<br><img src="Face.png">?
ex.a: The second one. Web pages are HTML: text plus tags such as <br> and <img src>. print() is a programming statement.
ex.az: 第二个。网页是 HTML，有 <br>、<img src> 等标记；print() 是程序语句。

ex.q: A club secretary with no coding skills needs a website by Friday. Which tool type?
ex.a: A drag-and-drop tool such as Google Sites, Wix or Weebly: no programming knowledge needed, templates provided.
ex.az: 拖放式工具（Google Sites、Wix、Weebly），不需编程。

ex.q: Chris says 'Developer Tools lets me permanently change Google's homepage for everyone.' True?
ex.a: No. Changes in Developer Tools affect only his own browser copy and vanish on reload; the file on the server is unchanged.
ex.az: 错。只改自己浏览器里的副本，重新载入就消失，伺服器文件不变。

cards.en:
Analogy: an HTML file is like a letter. The envelope says what it is (<!DOCTYPE html>). Inside, the header part has information about the letter (<head>), and the body is what people actually read (<body>).

  • <!DOCTYPE html>: tells the browser this is an HTML5 document.
  • <html>: the root element; everything else is inside it.
  • <head>: information about the file, e.g. <title> (text on the browser tab) and <script>. Not shown in the page itself.
  • <body>: all visible content: headings, paragraphs, tables, images, links.

Exam wording: The <html> element is the root element. <head> contains information about the file, such as the title and scripts. <body> is the container for all the visible content of the web page.

Two book TIPs: HTML tags are case insensitive (<title> = <TITLE>). Without <!DOCTYPE html> the browser runs the code in backward compatibility mode (old-style rules), so always put it on line 1.
cards.zh:
比喻：HTML 文件像一封信。信封写明是什么（<!DOCTYPE html>），里面 <head> 是关于这封信的资料，<body> 是读者真正看到的内容。

  • <!DOCTYPE html>：告诉浏览器这是 HTML5 文件。
  • <html>：根元素（root element），其他全部在里面。
  • <head>：文件资料，如 <title>（显示在浏览器分页上）和 <script>，不显示在页面中。
  • <body>：所有看得见的内容。

考试写法：The <html> element is the root element. <head> contains information about the file, such as the title and scripts. <body> is the container for all the visible content.

课本两个 TIP：HTML 标记不分大小写（<title> 等于 <TITLE>）。没有 <!DOCTYPE html>，浏览器会用向后兼容模式（backward compatibility mode）执行，所以第一行一定要写。

ex.q: Where does the text in <title>Shop</title> appear, and where must <title> be placed?
ex.a:
1. 'Shop' appears on the browser tab (title bar), not in the page.
2. <title> must be inside <head>.
ex.az: Shop 显示在浏览器分页上；<title> 要放在 <head> 里。

ex.q: A student puts <h1>Welcome</h1> inside <head>. What is wrong?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. <head> is for information about the file, not visible content.
2. Visible content like <h1> must go inside <body>.
ex.az: 常见错误。<head> 放文件资料，不放显示内容；<h1> 要放在 <body>。

ex.q: Put these in the right order: </body>, <html>, <head>…</head>, <body>, </html>, <!DOCTYPE html>.
ex.a:
1. <!DOCTYPE html>
2. <html>
3. <head>…</head>
4. <body>
5. </body>
6. </html>
ex.az: 次序：DOCTYPE → html → head → body → /body → /html。

ex.q: Is <BODY> wrong because it is in capitals?
ex.a: No. HTML tags are case insensitive, so <BODY> and <body> mean the same element.
ex.az: 不会错，HTML 标记不分大小写。

cards.en:
Analogy: a sandwich. The two slices of bread are the start tag and end tag; the filling is the content; the whole sandwich is the element. A sticker on the bread saying 'spicy' is an attribute (extra information).

  • Tag: keyword in angle brackets. Start tag <p>, end tag </p> (with a slash).
  • Element = start tag + content + end tag: <p>Hi</p>.
  • Empty element: no content, no end tag: <br>, <hr>, <img>.
  • Attribute: in the start tag, as name="value"; several are separated by spaces: <img src="a.png" alt="cat">.
  • Nesting: close in reverse order (last opened, first closed): <p><b>x</b></p>.

Exam wording: An element consists of a start tag, content and an end tag. Attributes are written in the start tag to provide additional information about an element.
cards.zh:
比喻：三文治：上下两片面包是开始标签和结束标签，馅料是内容，整个三文治是元素；面包上贴「辣」的贴纸是属性（额外资料）。

  • Tag：尖括号里的关键字，开始 <p>，结束 </p>。
  • Element = 开始标签 + 内容 + 结束标签。
  • Empty element：没有结束标签，如 <br>、<hr>、<img>。
  • Attribute：写在开始标签内，name="value"，多个用空格分隔。
  • 嵌套：后开先关：<p><b>x</b></p>。

考试写法：An element consists of a start tag, content and an end tag. Attributes are written in the start tag to provide additional information about an element.

ex.q: In <a href="x.html">Next</a>, name the tag, attribute, attribute value and content.
ex.a:
1. Tag name: a (anchor).
2. Attribute: href.
3. Value: x.html.
4. Content: Next (the text users click).
ex.az: 标签 a；属性 href；值 x.html；内容 Next。

ex.q: Find the error: <p><b>Important</p></b>
ex.a:
Common mistake: wrong nesting order.
1. <b> was opened last, so it must close first.
2. Correct: <p><b>Important</b></p>.
ex.az: 常见错误：嵌套次序错。后开的 <b> 要先关：<p><b>Important</b></p>。

ex.q: Which of these are empty elements: <p>, <br>, <img>, <h1>, <hr>?
ex.a:
1. Empty elements have no content and no end tag.
2. <br>, <img>, <hr> are empty.
3. <p> and <h1> wrap content, so they need end tags.
ex.az: <br>、<img>、<hr> 是空元素；<p>、<h1> 有内容，需要结束标签。

cards.t: Headings, paragraphs, line breaks and horizontal rules
cards.tz: 标题、段落、换行与水平线
cards.en:
Analogy: a newspaper has a big headline, smaller sub-headlines, and blocks of text. HTML gives you the same tools.

  • <h1>–<h6>: six levels of headings; h1 is the largest and most important, h6 the smallest.
  • <p>: a paragraph; the browser adds space before and after it.
  • <br>: line break (new line) inside the same paragraph.
  • <hr>: a horizontal rule (a line across the page).

Key rule: the browser ignores extra spaces and line breaks typed in the source code. Many spaces become one space; pressing Enter in the code does not make a new line. You must use <br> or a new <p>.

Exam wording: <h1> to <h6> define headings, <p> defines a paragraph, <br> inserts a line break and <hr> inserts a horizontal line. Extra spaces and line breaks in the source code are ignored by the browser.
cards.zh:
比喻：报纸有大标题、小标题和文字段落，HTML 也有一样的工具。

  • <h1>–<h6>：六级标题，h1 最大最重要。
  • <p>：段落，前后自动留空。
  • <br>：同一段内换行。
  • <hr>：水平线。

重点：浏览器会忽略源代码中多余的空格和换行：多个空格只当一个；在代码按 Enter 不会换行，要用 <br> 或新的 <p>。

考试写法：<h1> to <h6> define headings, <p> defines a paragraph, <br> inserts a line break and <hr> inserts a horizontal line. Extra spaces and line breaks in the source code are ignored.

ex.a:
1. <br> makes a new line after '1st line'.
2. The Enter key after '2nd line' is ignored (becomes a space).
3. Output:
This is the 1st line
This is the 2nd line This is also the 2nd line
ex.az:
1. <br> 后换行。
2. 代码中的 Enter 被忽略，变成空格。
3. 第二行显示两句连在一起。

ex.q: A student types <p>Name:     Tom</p> with 5 spaces, expecting a big gap. What appears?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Extra spaces collapse to one.
2. It shows 'Name: Tom'.
3. To keep spaces, use <pre> or  , or CSS.
ex.az: 常见错误。多个空格只显示一个，所以是 Name: Tom。要保留空格可用 <pre> 或  。

ex.q: Write HTML for: a main title 'Sports Day', a smaller title 'Results', a line, then a paragraph 'Class 5A won.'
ex.a:
1. <h1>Sports Day</h1>
2. <h2>Results</h2>
3. <hr>
4. <p>Class 5A won.</p>
ex.az: h1 主标题，h2 小标题，hr 水平线，p 段落。

cards.en:
Analogy: a comment is a pencil note in the margin for yourself: readers of the final page never see it. <pre> is like a photocopy: it keeps the text exactly as typed.

  • Comment: <!-- note -->. Not displayed; used to explain code for developers, or to hide code temporarily.
  • <pre>: preformatted text. Spaces and line breaks are kept exactly as typed, usually in a fixed-width (monospace) font. Good for code, poems with spacing, ASCII diagrams.

Exam wording: Comments <!-- … --> are not displayed by the browser. The <pre> element displays preformatted text, keeping all spaces and line breaks.
cards.zh:
比喻：注释像页边的铅笔笔记，只给自己看；<pre> 像影印，原样保留。

  • 注释：<!-- note -->，不会显示，用来向开发者解释代码或暂时隐藏代码。
  • <pre>：预格式文字，保留所有空格和换行，通常用等宽字体。适合代码、排版特别的诗、ASCII 图。

考试写法：Comments <!-- … --> are not displayed by the browser. The <pre> element displays preformatted text, keeping all spaces and line breaks.

ex.q: A student wants to show a poem with its exact spacing and line breaks. Which tag, and why?
ex.a:
1. Use <pre>.
2. In <p>, extra spaces and line breaks would be ignored.
3. <pre> keeps them exactly as typed.
ex.az: 用 <pre>；<p> 会忽略多余空格换行，<pre> 原样保留。

ex.q: A developer writes <!- old menu -> to hide some code, but the text still shows. Why?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. A comment must start with <!-- (two dashes) and end with -->.
2. With one dash it is not a comment.
3. Correct: <!-- old menu -->.
ex.az: 常见错误。注释要用两个横线：<!-- 和 -->。

ex.q:
What is displayed?
<p>Price <!-- check later --> $20</p>
ex.a:
1. The comment is removed from the display.
2. Shown: Price $20.
ex.az: 注释不显示，结果是 Price $20。

notes.tz: 预格式文字开始，换行会保留

notes.t: Spaces kept exactly; end of pre
notes.tz: 空格原样保留；pre 结束

cards.en:
Analogy: like the B, I, U buttons in Word, but written as tags around the text.

CodeEffect
<b>bold</b>bold
<i>italic</i>italic
<u>underline</u>underline
x<sup>2</sup>superscript: x2 (raised)
H<sub>2</sub>Osubscript: H2O (lowered)
  • Tags can be nested: <b><i>both</i></b>.
  • Avoid underlining normal text: users may think it is a link.

Exam wording: <b>, <i> and <u> make text bold, italic and underlined; <sup> and <sub> display superscript and subscript.
cards.zh:
比喻：像 Word 的 B、I、U 按钮，只是写成标签包住文字。

  • <b> 粗体，<i> 斜体，<u> 底线。
  • <sup> 上标：x2；<sub> 下标：H2O。
  • 可嵌套：<b><i>both</i></b>。
  • 一般文字不要加底线，用户会以为是超连结。

考试写法：<b>, <i> and <u> make text bold, italic and underlined; <sup> and <sub> display superscript and subscript.

ex.q: Write HTML for E = mc² and CO₂.
ex.a:
1. Raised 2 → superscript: E = mc<sup>2</sup>
2. Lowered 2 → subscript: CO<sub>2</sub>
ex.az: 升高用 sup：mc<sup>2</sup>；降低用 sub：CO<sub>2</sub>。

ex.q: A student writes H<sup>2</sup>O for water. What is wrong?
ex.a:
Common mistake: sup vs sub mixed up.
1. <sup> raises the 2 → H²O (wrong).
2. Water needs a lowered 2 → H<sub>2</sub>O.
Memory tip: sup = up.
ex.az: 常见错误：上下标调转。水要下标：H<sub>2</sub>O。记法：sup 有 up = 上。

ex.q: Write HTML so that 'Warning' is both bold and italic.
ex.a:
1. Nest the two tags.
2. Close in reverse order: <b><i>Warning</i></b>
ex.az: 嵌套两个标签，后开先关：<b><i>Warning</i></b>。

cards.t: The style attribute: font, size and alignment
cards.tz: style 属性：字体、大小与对齐
cards.en:
Analogy: the style attribute is a sticky note on one element saying how it should look. Only that element is affected.

Syntax: style="property:value; property:value" — colon between property and value, semicolon between pairs.

  • font-family: the typeface, e.g. Arial, Times New Roman, Comic Sans MS.
  • font-size: in px (pixels), e.g. 10px, or keywords xx-small, x-small, small, medium, large, x-large, xx-large.
  • text-align: left / right / center (American spelling!).

Exam wording: The style attribute applies CSS properties to an element, e.g. style="font-family:Arial; font-size:24px; text-align:center".
cards.zh:
比喻：style 属性像贴在某个元素上的便条，只说明这一个元素的样子。

语法：style="property:value; property:value"：属性和值之间用冒号，每对之间用分号。

  • font-family：字体，如 Arial。
  • font-size：用 px（像素）或关键字 xx-small … xx-large。
  • text-align：left / right / center（注意美式拼法 center）。

考试写法：The style attribute applies CSS properties to an element, e.g. style="font-family:Arial; font-size:24px; text-align:center".

ex.q: Write one paragraph 'Notice' in Arial, 24px, centred.
ex.a:
1. Three properties in one style attribute.
2. Separate with semicolons:
<p style="font-family:Arial; font-size:24px; text-align:center">Notice</p>
ex.az: 一个 style 里写三个属性，用分号分隔。

ex.q: Why does <p style="text-align:centre"> not centre the text?
ex.a:
Common mistake: spelling.
1. CSS uses American spelling: center.
2. The browser ignores an unknown value 'centre', so the text stays left.
3. Correct: text-align:center.
ex.az: 常见错误：拼法。CSS 要写 center，写 centre 会被忽略。

ex.q: A student writes style="font-size:20px font-family:Arial". What happens?
ex.a:
1. The semicolon between the two properties is missing.
2. The browser cannot read the value '20px font-family:Arial' → the declaration is invalid.
3. Fix: style="font-size:20px; font-family:Arial".
ex.az: 漏了分号，整句无效。改为 font-size:20px; font-family:Arial。

cards.t: Colours: color, background-color and hex codes
cards.tz: 颜色：color、background-color 与十六进制代码
cards.en:
Analogy: a screen pixel is three tiny lamps: red, green, blue. A hex code says how bright each lamp is.

  • color: text colour. background-color: background colour.
  • Values: a name (red, yellow) or a hex RGB code #RRGGBB. Each pair is 00–FF in hexadecimal = 0–255 in decimal: the brightness of Red, Green, Blue.
CodeColour
#FF0000red
#00FF00green (lime)
#0000FFblue
#FFFF00yellow (red + green)
#FF00FFmagenta (red + blue)
#000000 / #FFFFFFblack (all off) / white (all on)

Larger value = brighter. Equal R, G, B = a grey.

Exam wording: Colours can be given as hexadecimal RGB codes #RRGGBB, where each pair (00–FF) represents the intensity of red, green and blue.

From the book (STEAM box): colours are light waves of different wavelengths. Humans see about 400–700 nm (purple ~380–450, blue 450–495, green 495–570, yellow 570–590, orange 590–620, red 620–750). White light through a prism splits into the visible spectrum (a rainbow). The RGB model adds the three primary colours red, green and blue in different amounts; all wavelengths together = white. Each of R, G, B is 0–255 (00–FF), so there are 256 × 256 × 256 colours (≈16.7 million). Book table: Orange #ffa500 (255,165,0), BlueViolet #8a2be2 (138,43,226), Chocolate #d2691e (210,105,30).
cards.zh:
比喻：每个像素有红、绿、蓝三盏小灯，十六进制代码说明每盏灯有多亮。

  • color：文字颜色；background-color：背景颜色。
  • 可用颜色名，或 #RRGGBB：每对 00–FF（十进制 0–255）代表红、绿、蓝的强度。
  • #FF0000 红、#00FF00 绿、#0000FF 蓝、#FFFF00 黄（红+绿）、#FF00FF 洋红（红+蓝）、#000000 黑、#FFFFFF 白。
  • 数值越大越亮；三个值相同就是灰色。

考试写法：Colours can be given as hexadecimal RGB codes #RRGGBB, where each pair (00–FF) represents the intensity of red, green and blue.

课本 STEAM 补充：颜色是不同波长的光波，人眼可见约 400–700 nm（紫 380–450、蓝 450–495、绿 495–570、黄 570–590、橙 590–620、红 620–750）。白光经棱镜分成可见光谱（彩虹）。RGB 模型把红绿蓝三原色按比例相加；所有波长合起来是白色。R、G、B 各 0–255（00–FF），共 256 × 256 × 256 种颜色（约 1670 万）。课本表：Orange #ffa500 (255,165,0)、BlueViolet #8a2be2 (138,43,226)、Chocolate #d2691e (210,105,30)。

ex.q: What colour is #FF00FF?
ex.a:
1. Split: R = FF (255), G = 00 (0), B = FF (255).
2. Full red + full blue, no green.
3. → magenta / purple-pink.

ex.q: Which is redder, #FF0101 or #E00000?
ex.a:
1. Red part: FF = 255 vs E0 = 14×16 = 224.
2. #FF0101 has more red (the 01s add almost nothing).
3. So #FF0101 is the brighter red; #E00000 is slightly darker.
ex.az: FF=255 > E0=224，所以 #FF0101 较红较亮。

ex.q: A student wants white text on a black heading and writes style="color:#000000; background-color:#FFFFFF". What appears?
ex.a:
Common mistake: swapped values.
1. color is the TEXT colour → #000000 = black text.
2. background-color #FFFFFF = white background.
3. Result: black on white, the opposite. Fix: color:#FFFFFF; background-color:#000000.
ex.az: 常见错误：调转。color 是文字色。应写 color:#FFFFFF; background-color:#000000。

ex.q: How many different colours can a #RRGGBB code give? (DSE 2015 1A Q27 type)
Convert Chocolate #d2691e to R, G, B.

cards.t: Combining styles, background images, audio and video
cards.tz: 组合样式、背景图片、声音与影片
cards.en:
Plain idea: one style attribute can hold many settings, and HTML can show more than text and pictures.

  • Several style values in one attribute are separated by ;: style="font-family:Comic Sans Ms;font-size:50px;color:#0000FF;text-align:center;background-color:orange".
  • background-image:url("URL") sets a background picture for an element.
  • Use American spellings (color, center), or the style will not work.
  • A font must already be installed on the computer, or the browser cannot show it.
  • Other multimedia: <audio> for sound and <video> for video files.

Exam wording: Multiple style values are separated by semicolons; multimedia such as audio and video can be embedded with <audio> and <video>.
cards.zh:
简单说：一个 style 属性可放多个设定；HTML 不只能放文字和图片。

  • 同一 style 里的多个值用 ; 分隔。
  • background-image:url("URL") 设定元件的背景图片。
  • 要用美式拼法（color、center），否则样式无效。
  • 字体必须已安装在电脑上，浏览器才能显示。
  • 其他多媒体：<audio> 放声音、<video> 放影片。

考试写法：Multiple style values are separated by semicolons; multimedia such as audio and video can be embedded with <audio> and <video>.

ex.q: Write one <p> that is red, 30px and centred.
ex.a: <p style="color:red;font-size:30px;text-align:center">Hi</p>
ex.az: 用分号把三个值连起来。

ex.q: Ada writes style="colour:red; text-align:centre". Nothing changes. Why?
ex.a: British spellings. CSS needs color and center.
ex.az: 用了英式拼法，要写 color 和 center。

ex.q: Add a sound file song.mp3 with play controls.
ex.a: <audio src="song.mp3" controls></audio>
ex.az: 用 <audio> 加 controls。

notes.tz: 五个样式值用分号连起来

cards.en:
Analogy: a shopping list (order doesn't matter, use bullets) versus recipe steps (order matters, use numbers).

  • <ul>: unordered list with bullets. type="circle" or type="square" changes the bullet.
  • <ol>: ordered list, numbered 1, 2, 3. type="a" → a, b, c; type="A" → A, B, C; type="i" → i, ii, iii; type="I" → I, II, III.
  • Every item uses <li> (list item), inside the ul/ol.

Lists are easier to read than long paragraphs.

Exam wording: <ul> creates an unordered (bulleted) list and <ol> creates an ordered (numbered) list; each item is defined by <li>.
cards.zh:
比喻：购物清单（次序不重要，用圆点）对比食谱步骤（次序重要，用编号）。

  • <ul>：无序清单，圆点；type="circle"/"square" 改符号。
  • <ol>：有序清单 1、2、3；type="a" → a,b,c；"A" → A,B,C；"i" → i,ii,iii；"I" → I,II,III。
  • 每项用 <li>。

考试写法：<ul> creates an unordered (bulleted) list and <ol> creates an ordered (numbered) list; each item is defined by <li>.

ex.q: Write a list numbered i, ii, iii: Wash, Cut, Cook.
ex.az: 有次序用 ol，小写罗马数字用 type="i"。

ex.q: A student wants a numbered list and writes <ul type="1">. What appears?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. <ul> always gives bullets; type="1" is not a valid ul type.
2. Use <ol> for numbers (type="1" is the default).
ex.az: 常见错误。ul 永远是圆点，要编号就用 ol。

ex.q: Write a bulleted list with square bullets of three fruits.
ex.a:
<ul type="square">
  <li>Apple</li>
  <li>Orange</li>
  <li>Pear</li>
</ul>
ex.az: ul 加 type="square"，每项用 li。

cards.en:
Analogy: building a table is like filling an egg tray row by row: first say 'new row' (<tr>), then put each cell in that row.

  • <table>: the table. <tr>: table row. <th>: header cell (bold, centred). <td>: data cell.
  • border attribute: border thickness (0 = none).
  • border-spacing (CSS): space between cells.
  • padding (CSS): space inside a cell, between content and its border.
  • height, vertical-align (top / middle / bottom) for rows or cells.

Counting: rows = number of <tr>; columns = cells in one <tr>.

Exam wording: <table> defines a table, <tr> a table row, <th> a header cell and <td> a data cell. Padding is the space between the cell content and its border; border-spacing is the space between cells.

Book's style values for tables: height / width (pixels or %, on table, tr, th, td); padding = space between a cell and its content; border-spacing = space between cells (on table). The border attribute sets the border thickness. Several attributes are separated by spaces, several style values by ;, e.g. <tr style="height:50;vertical-align:top">.
cards.zh:
比喻：做表格像一行一行放蛋格：先说「新的一行」（<tr>），再放这一行的每个格。

  • <table> 表格；<tr> 行；<th> 标题格（粗体置中）；<td> 资料格。
  • border：边框粗细（0 = 无）。
  • border-spacing：格与格之间的距离。
  • padding：格内内容与边框的距离。
  • height、vertical-align（top/middle/bottom）。

行数 = <tr> 数目；列数 = 一个 <tr> 里的格数。

考试写法：<table> defines a table, <tr> a table row, <th> a header cell and <td> a data cell. Padding is the space between the cell content and its border; border-spacing is the space between cells.

课本的表格样式值：height／width（像素或百分比，可用于 table、tr、th、td）；padding＝储存格与内容之间的距离；border-spacing＝储存格之间的距离（用于 table）。border 属性设边框粗细。多个属性用空格分隔，多个样式值用 ; 分隔。

ex.q: The demo table has 2 <tr>, each with 1 <th> and 2 <td>. How many rows and columns?
ex.a:
1. Rows = number of <tr> = 2.
2. Columns = cells per row = 1 + 2 = 3.

ex.q: What is the difference between padding and border-spacing?
ex.a:
1. padding: gap inside one cell, between the text and that cell's border.
2. border-spacing: gap between two neighbouring cells.
ex.az: padding 是格内文字与边框的距离；border-spacing 是格与格之间的距离。

ex.q: A student writes <table><td>A</td><td>B</td></table> and also wants C, D on a second row by just adding two more <td>. What goes wrong?
ex.a:
Common mistake: no <tr>.
1. Without <tr>, all cells stay in one row: A B C D.
2. Every row needs its own <tr>:
<table border="1">
  <tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr>
  <tr><td>C</td><td>D</td></tr>
</table>
ex.az: 常见错误：没有 <tr>。每一行都要用 <tr> 包住。

ex.q: padding vs border-spacing: which one puts a gap between two neighbouring cells?
ex.a: border-spacing. padding is the space inside a cell, between its border and the content.
ex.az: border-spacing 是格与格之间；padding 是格内边框与内容之间。

demo.html:
Title 1 row 1 cell 1 row 1 cell 2
Title 2 row 2 cell 1 row 2 cell 2

code.src:
Title 1 row 1 cell 1 row 1 cell 2
Title 2 row 2 cell 1 row 2 cell 2

notes.t: Row 1: 50px high, content at the top

cards.tz: 合并储存格：colspan 与 rowspan
cards.en:
Analogy: in a classroom seating plan, a big teacher's desk can take the space of 2 seats side by side (colspan) or 2 seats front-to-back (rowspan). Those seats then don't exist any more.

  • colspan="n": the cell stretches across n columns to the right, in the same row.
  • rowspan="n": the cell stretches down n rows.
  • Key rule: positions covered by a merged cell must not get their own <td>. So the next row(s) have fewer <td>.
  • Check: every row should add up to the same number of columns (count colspan values, and include cells coming down from rowspans above).

Exam wording: colspan specifies the number of columns a cell should span; rowspan specifies the number of rows a cell should span.
cards.zh:
比喻：课室座位表里，老师的大桌可以占左右两个位（colspan），或前后两个位（rowspan），被占的位就不再存在。

  • colspan="n"：横跨 n 列。
  • rowspan="n"：向下跨 n 行。
  • 重点：被合并覆盖的位置不能再写 <td>，所以后面的行 td 会较少。
  • 检查：每行加起来的列数要相同（计 colspan，也计上面 rowspan 伸下来的格）。

考试写法：colspan specifies the number of columns a cell should span; rowspan specifies the number of rows a cell should span.

ex.q: In the demo, why does row 3 have only one <td>?
ex.a:
1. The table has 2 columns.
2. Cell B in row 2 has rowspan="2", so it also fills column 1 of row 3.
3. Row 3 only needs a cell for column 2 → D.
ex.az: B 的 rowspan=2 已占了第三行第一列，所以第三行只需 D。

ex.q: A 3-column timetable: 'Mon' in column 1 should cover rows 2 and 3. Write rows 2–3.
ex.a:
1. Row 2: Mon with rowspan="2", then two lessons.
2. Row 3: column 1 is taken by Mon, so only two cells.
<tr><th rowspan="2">Mon</th><td>Maths</td><td>ICT</td></tr>
<tr><td>Chem</td><td>Phy</td></tr>
ex.az: 第二行 Mon 用 rowspan=2；第三行只写两格。

ex.q:
A student writes:
<tr><td colspan="2">A</td><td>X</td></tr>
<tr><td>B</td><td>C</td></tr>
for a 2-column table. What is wrong?
ex.a:
Common mistake: extra cell.
1. Row 1: colspan 2 + 1 cell = 3 columns.
2. Row 2 has only 2 → the table is uneven; X sticks out.
3. Remove <td>X</td> so row 1 = 2 columns.
ex.az: 常见错误：多了一格。第一行 2+1=3 列，第二行只有 2 列，要删去 X。

notes.t: Start a table with a border
Row 1: one cell spanning both columns
Row 2: B spans rows 2 and 3; C in column 2
notes.tz: 第二行：B 向下跨两行；C 在第二列

notes.t: Row 3: column 1 taken by B, so only D
notes.tz: 第三行：第一列被 B 占了，只写 D

cards.t: Images: img, src, alt, width and height
cards.en:
Analogy: <img> is a photo frame on the wall. src is the address telling you where the photo is kept; alt is the label under the frame, read out if the photo is missing.

  • src: path to the image file. Relative: orange.png (same folder), images/orange.png (subfolder). Absolute: a full URL.
  • alt: alternative text, shown if the image cannot be displayed, and read aloud by screen readers (accessibility).
  • width / height: size in pixels. Set only one to keep the aspect ratio (shape).
  • <img> is an empty element (no end tag).
  • Audio and video use <audio> and <video> (with controls).

Broken image? Check file name, extension, upper/lower case and folder.

Exam wording: The src attribute specifies the path of the image; the alt attribute provides alternative text that is displayed if the image cannot be shown and can be read by screen readers.
cards.zh:
比喻：<img> 像墙上的相框：src 是相片放在哪里的地址；alt 是相框下的说明牌，相片不见时会读出来。

  • src：图片路径。相对路径：orange.png（同一文件夹）、images/orange.png（子文件夹）；绝对路径：完整网址。
  • alt：替代文字，图片无法显示时显示，屏幕阅读器会读出。
  • width / height：像素大小，只设一个会保持比例。
  • <img> 是空元素。音频、影片用 <audio>、<video>。

考试写法：The src attribute specifies the path of the image; the alt attribute provides alternative text that is displayed if the image cannot be shown and can be read by screen readers.

ex.q: Photo cat.JPG is in subfolder 'pics'. <img src="cat.jpg"> shows a broken image. Give two possible errors and fix the code.
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Wrong folder: the file is in pics/, so the path must include it.
2. Wrong case: the server may treat .JPG and .jpg as different.
3. Missing alt text.
Fix: <img src="pics/cat.JPG" alt="a cat">
ex.az: 常见错误。漏了文件夹 pics/；扩展名大小写不符；也没有 alt。改为 src="pics/cat.JPG" alt="a cat"。

ex.q: An image is 400×200 px. The code has height="100" only. What is the displayed width?
ex.a:
1. Only height is set, so the aspect ratio is kept.
2. 200 → 100 is half, so width = 400 ÷ 2 = 200 px.
ex.az: 只设 height，保持比例：高度减半，宽也减半 → 200px。

ex.q: Give two reasons to always write alt text.
ex.a:
1. If the image fails to load, the alt text tells users what it was.
2. Screen readers read alt text to visually impaired users (accessibility).
3. (Also helps search engines understand the image.)
ex.az: 图片载入失败时显示说明；屏幕阅读器读给视障人士听。

demo.html:
This is an orange

Broken path below: the alt text shows instead

notes.t: Show orange.png from the same folder, 150px high (width keeps ratio); alt text 'orange'
notes.tz: 显示同一文件夹的 orange.png，高 150px，宽保持比例；替代文字 orange

notes.t: Insert a video with play/pause controls

cards.tz: 用 anchor 标签建立超连结
cards.en:
Analogy: a hyperlink is a door. The text or picture between <a> and </a> is the door handle; href is the room it opens into.

  • Hyperlinks are defined with the anchor tag <a>; href gives the destination.
  • Destination can be: an external website (absolute URL https://…), another page in the same site (relative path about.html), a place on a page (#part1), or an email (mailto:info@abcss.edu.hk).
  • Image link: put <img> inside <a>.
  • target="_blank" opens the link in a new tab.
  • Hyperlinks support the architecture (structure) of the whole website.

Exam wording: A hyperlink is created with the anchor element <a>; the href attribute specifies the destination URL, and the content between the tags is the clickable part.
cards.zh:
比喻：超连结是一道门：<a> 和 </a> 之间的文字或图片是门柄，href 是门后的房间。

  • 超连结用 <a> 定义，href 指明目的地。
  • 目的地可以是：外部网站（绝对 URL）、同站另一页（相对路径 about.html）、页内位置（#part1）、电邮（mailto:）。
  • 图片连结：把 <img> 放进 <a>。
  • target="_blank"：在新分页打开。
  • 超连结支撑整个网站的架构。

考试写法：A hyperlink is created with the anchor element <a>; the href attribute specifies the destination URL, and the content between the tags is the clickable part.

ex.q: Make the school logo logo.png a link to index.html.
ex.a:
1. Put the img inside the a element.
2. <a href="index.html"><img src="logo.png" alt="Home"></a>
3. Clicking the logo opens index.html.
ex.az: 把 img 放入 a：<a href="index.html"><img src="logo.png" alt="Home"></a>。

ex.q: A student writes <a href="www.google.com">Google</a>. Clicking gives 'page not found'. Why?
ex.a:
Common mistake: missing https://
1. Without the protocol, the browser treats www.google.com as a file in the current folder (relative path).
2. Fix: href="https://www.google.com".
ex.az: 常见错误：漏了 https://。浏览器以为是同一文件夹内的文件。

ex.q: Write a link 'Email us' that opens the email program to info@abcss.edu.hk.
ex.a: <a href="mailto:info@abcss.edu.hk">Email us</a>
ex.az: 用 mailto:：<a href="mailto:info@abcss.edu.hk">Email us</a>。

notes.t: External link: absolute URL; 'Go to Google' is clickable
notes.tz: 外部连结：绝对网址；Go to Google 可点击

notes.t: Relative path: a file in the same folder
notes.tz: 相对路径：同一文件夹的文件

notes.t: Image link: clicking the picture opens home.html
notes.tz: 图片连结：点击图片打开 home.html

cards.en:
Analogy: bookmarks in a long book. You first stick a bookmark with a name (the anchor), then a link says 'jump to bookmark part2'.

  1. Mark the target: <a name="part2">…</a> (in HTML5, id="part2" on any element works the same).
  2. Link to it with #: <a href="#part2">Go to part 2</a>.
  3. Anchor on another page: href="page2.html#part2".

Useful for long pages, FAQs, tables of contents, and a 'Back to top' link.

Exam wording: If the destination is an anchor on the same page, the symbol "#" must be added before the anchor name in href, e.g. href="#part2".
cards.zh:
比喻：长书里的书签：先贴一个有名字的书签（anchor），连结就说「跳到书签 part2」。

  1. 标记目的地：<a name="part2">（HTML5 可在任何元素用 id="part2"）。
  2. 用 # 连过去：<a href="#part2">。
  3. 另一页的锚点：href="page2.html#part2"。

适合长页、FAQ、目录、「回到顶部」。

考试写法：If the destination is an anchor on the same page, the symbol "#" must be added before the anchor name in href, e.g. href="#part2".

ex.q: Create a 'Back to top' link at the bottom of a long page.
ex.a:
1. At the top: <a name="top"></a> (or <h1 id="top">).
2. At the bottom: <a href="#top">Back to top</a>.
ex.az: 顶部放锚点 name="top"，底部写 href="#top"。

ex.q: A student writes <a href="part2">Go</a> to jump to <a name="part2"> on the same page. What happens?
ex.a:
Common mistake: missing #.
1. Without #, the browser looks for a FILE called 'part2' → not found.
2. Fix: href="#part2".
ex.az: 常见错误：漏了 #。没有 # 浏览器会找名为 part2 的文件。

ex.q: Link to the anchor 'faq' on the page help.html.
ex.a: <a href="help.html#faq">See FAQ</a> — file name, then #, then the anchor name.
ex.az: 文件名 + # + 锚点名：help.html#faq。

cards.en:
Analogy: an iframe is a window in a wall: through it you see a different room (another web page) while staying in your own room.

  • Frames embed another HTML file in the current file and create a specific window (frame) to display it.
  • Old <frameset>/<frame> were removed in HTML5.
  • Use <iframe> (inline frame) with src (which page), width and height. It needs an end tag </iframe>.
  • Uses: embed a map, a video player, or another page of your site.

Exam wording: An iframe (inline frame) embeds another HTML document within the current web page; src specifies the page and width/height set the size of the frame.
cards.zh:
比喻：iframe 像墙上的窗：你留在自己房间，却看到另一个房间（另一个网页）。

  • 框架把另一个 HTML 文件嵌入目前文件，并开一个特定窗口显示它。
  • 旧的 <frameset>/<frame> 在 HTML5 已删除。
  • 用 <iframe>：src（哪一页）、width、height；要有 </iframe>。
  • 用途：嵌入地图、影片播放器、站内另一页。

考试写法：An iframe (inline frame) embeds another HTML document within the current web page; src specifies the page and width/height set the size of the frame.

ex.q: Embed news.html in a 600×300 window below a heading 'Latest'.
ex.a:
<h1>Latest</h1>
<iframe src="news.html" width="600" height="300"></iframe>
ex.az: h1 下面放 iframe，src=news.html，600×300。

ex.q: A student uses <frameset><frame src="a.html"></frameset> in an HTML5 page. Problem?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. <frameset> and <frame> were removed in HTML5.
2. Use <iframe src="a.html"></iframe> instead.
ex.az: 常见错误。HTML5 已删除 frameset/frame，改用 iframe。

ex.q: How many separate HTML documents does the browser load for a home page containing two iframes (A.html and B.html)?
ex.a:
1. The home page itself: 1.
2. Each iframe loads its own document: A.html, B.html.
3. Total 3 HTML documents.
ex.az: 主页 1 个 + 两个 iframe 各 1 个 = 3 个。

demo.html: This is the homepage

cards.tz: HTML 电邮与纯文字电邮
cards.en:
Analogy: a plain-text email is a handwritten note; an HTML email is a printed flyer with colours and pictures.

HTML emailPlain-text email
LooksFormatting: colours, bold, images, links, tables (a mini web page)No formatting
SizeLargerSmaller
SafetyLink text can hide a different (malicious) addressLess able to hide links

Both can be received with POP3 or IMAP; the format does not change the protocol.

Exam wording: Emails can be written in HTML format, which allows text formatting, images and hyperlinks, making them more attractive.
cards.zh:
比喻：纯文字电邮像手写便条；HTML 电邮像印刷的彩色传单。

  • HTML 电邮：可有颜色、粗体、图片、超连结、表格，较吸引；但文件较大，连结文字可能隐藏恶意网址。
  • 纯文字电邮：没有格式，较小，较难隐藏连结。
  • 两者都可用 POP3 或 IMAP 接收，格式不影响协定。

考试写法：Emails can be written in HTML format, which allows text formatting, images and hyperlinks, making them more attractive.

ex.q: State one advantage of sending a newsletter as an HTML email.
ex.a:
1. It can include formatting, images and hyperlinks.
2. So the newsletter is more attractive and readers can click links directly.
ex.az: 可加入格式、图片、超连结，更吸引，读者可直接点击。

ex.q: Give one disadvantage of HTML email.
ex.a:
1. Link text can show one address but link to another (e.g. phishing).
2. Or: larger size than plain text.
ex.az: 连结文字可隐藏另一个网址（钓鱼）；或文件较大。

ex.q: A student says 'HTML emails need a special protocol, so IMAP cannot receive them.' Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. POP3/IMAP just transfer the message content.
2. HTML is only the format of the content.
3. Both formats work with POP3 and IMAP.
ex.az: 常见错误。POP3/IMAP 只负责传送，HTML 只是内容格式，两种格式都可接收。

notes.tz: 彩色标题：只有 HTML 电邮能做到

notes.t: Clickable link; the shown text can differ from the real address
notes.tz: 可点击连结；显示文字可与真实网址不同

cards.tz: 网站结构：线性、层次、矩阵
cards.en:
Analogy: plan the site like an essay outline before writing. Website design = architecture design (structure) + interface design (look). Most sites have Home, About Us and Contact Us.

StructureShapeGood for
LinearPages one after another (Previous / Next), like a trainTutorials, step-by-step guides, stories
HierarchicalA tree: Home → categories → sub-pagesMost websites: school, shop
Matrix (web)Pages linked to many others; jump freelyWikis, encyclopedias; flexible but can confuse users without good navigation

Exam wording: A linear structure links pages one after another in sequence; a hierarchical structure organises pages in a tree from the homepage to categories and sub-pages; a matrix structure interlinks pages so users can jump freely between them. A well-organised architecture strengthens the user experience.
cards.zh:
比喻：建站前先像写作文大纲一样规划。网站设计 = 架构设计 + 界面设计，多数网站有 Home、About Us、Contact Us。

  • Linear（线性）：页面一页接一页（上一页/下一页），像火车。适合教学、步骤、故事。
  • Hierarchical（层次）：树状：主页 → 类别 → 子页。大部分网站用（学校、网店）。
  • Matrix（矩阵/网状）：页面互相连结，可自由跳转。灵活，但导航不好会令人迷路。

考试写法：A linear structure links pages one after another in sequence; a hierarchical structure organises pages in a tree; a matrix structure interlinks pages so users can jump freely. A well-organised architecture strengthens the user experience.

ex.q: Choose a structure for (a) a 10-step tutorial on installing software, (b) a secondary school website.
ex.a:
(a) Steps must be followed in order → linear.
(b) Many sections (About, Subjects, Admission) each with sub-pages → hierarchical.
ex.az: (a) 有次序 → 线性；(b) 多个类别和子页 → 层次。

ex.q: An online encyclopedia lets readers jump from any article to related articles. Which structure?
ex.a:
1. Pages link to many other pages, not one parent.
2. → matrix (web) structure.
3. Needs a search box/navigation so users don't get lost.
ex.az: 页面互相连结 → 矩阵结构，要有搜寻/导航避免迷路。

ex.q: A student designs a shop site as linear: Home → Phones → Laptops → Cameras → Contact (Next buttons only). What's wrong?
ex.a:
Common mistake: wrong structure for the purpose.
1. A customer wanting Contact must click through every page.
2. A shop has independent categories → use hierarchical, with links from Home to each category.
ex.az: 常见错误：结构不合用途。顾客要逐页按才到 Contact；网店应用层次结构。

frames.en: One page after another: Page 1 → 2 → 3 → 4.
frames.zh: 一页接一页。

frames.en: A tree: Home branches to categories, categories to sub-pages.
frames.zh: 树状：主页分到类别，类别再分子页。

frames.en: Pages interlinked; users jump freely between any pages.
frames.zh: 页面互相连结，可自由跳转。

cards.en:
Analogy: a restaurant. UI is the decoration, menu design and plates (what you see and touch). UX is your whole visit: was it easy to order, fast, pleasant? A beautiful restaurant with a 1-hour wait has good UI but bad UX.

  • UI (User Interface): the graphic design and appearance of the page: buttons, icons, colours, fonts, layout. Done by a UI designer.
  • UX (User Experience): users' impression and overall experience when browsing. A UX designer studies user needs.
  • User research should be conducted before designing, to satisfy users as much as possible.
  • Different purpose and target audience → different design: elderly → large text, simple navigation; children → bright colours, pictures.

Exam wording: UI refers to the graphic design and appearance of a web page, including buttons, icons and other visual elements. UX refers to users' impression of the website and their overall experience when browsing it.
cards.zh:
比喻：餐厅：UI 是装修、餐牌设计、碗碟（看到摸到的）；UX 是整次用餐体验：点餐容易吗、快不快、舒服吗。装修靓但要等一小时 = UI 好、UX 差。

  • UI（用户界面）：网页的图像设计与外观：按钮、图标、颜色、字体、版面。
  • UX（用户体验）：用户浏览时的整体感受。
  • 设计前应先做用户研究，尽量满足用户。
  • 目的和对象不同，设计不同：长者 → 大字、简单导航；儿童 → 鲜色、图片。

考试写法：UI refers to the graphic design and appearance of a web page, including buttons, icons and other visual elements. UX refers to users' impression of the website and their overall experience when browsing it.

ex.q: A banking app looks beautiful but users need 8 taps to transfer money. UI or UX problem?
ex.a:
1. The look is fine → UI is OK.
2. The task is slow and annoying → poor UX.
3. Fix: shorten the transfer flow (fewer steps).
ex.az: 外观好 = UI 没问题；操作繁复 = UX 差。

ex.q: A student says 'UX is just choosing nice colours.' Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake: mixing UI and UX.
1. Choosing colours/fonts is UI.
2. UX is the whole experience: ease of finding info, speed, number of steps, satisfaction.
ex.az: 常见错误：混淆 UI 和 UX。选颜色是 UI；UX 是整体体验。

ex.q: Suggest two design choices for a website for elderly users.
ex.a:
1. Large font and large buttons (easy to read and tap).
2. Simple navigation with few options, concise and neat structure.
ex.az: 大字大按钮；导航简单、结构简洁。

demo.html:
One task, two designs. Which feels better to use?

Design A
→ → →
Design B

cards.en:
Analogy: before painting, an artist makes a pencil sketch. A wireframe is the pencil sketch of a web page.

  • It shows where things go using simple boxes: header/logo, navigation bar, images, text blocks, footer.
  • Keep it simple; it does not need to be perfect. Colour design can be decided later.
  • Why: the team agrees on content and layout early, so changes are cheap (moving a box on paper is easier than rewriting code).

Exam wording: Before actually creating a web page, sketching a wireframe helps us plan the content and layout of the page.
cards.zh:
比喻：画画前先用铅笔起稿。线框图（wireframe）就是网页的铅笔草稿。

  • 用简单方框表示东西放在哪里：页首/标志、导航栏、图片、文字区、页尾。
  • 简单就好，不用完美；颜色设计可以之后再决定。
  • 好处：团队早期就版面达成共识，修改成本低。

考试写法：Before actually creating a web page, sketching a wireframe helps us plan the content and layout of the page.

ex.q: List the boxes you would draw in a wireframe for a restaurant homepage.
ex.a:
1. Header with logo and restaurant name.
2. Navigation bar: Menu, Booking, Location, Contact.
3. Large image box (signature dish).
4. Text box: short introduction / opening hours.
5. Footer: address, phone, social links.
ex.az: 页首+标志；导航栏；大图片；简介/营业时间；页尾联络资料。

ex.q: A student spends two days choosing exact colours and fonts in her wireframe. Good use of time?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. A wireframe only plans content and layout.
2. It should be simple; colours and fonts come later in the visual design.
3. She should finish the layout first so others can comment early.
ex.az: 常见错误。线框图只规划内容和版面，颜色字体之后再定。

ex.q: Give one benefit of drawing a wireframe before coding.
ex.a: Changes in layout are found early, when moving a box is quick and cheap, instead of rewriting HTML later.
ex.az: 早发现版面问题，在纸上移方框比改代码便宜快捷。

demo.html:
LOGO | Restaurant name
Menu | Booking | Location | Contact
[ big image ]
Intro text
Opening hours
Footer: address, phone

code.src:
LOGO | Restaurant name
Menu | Booking | Location | Contact

Footer: address, phone

notes.t: Header box: just a labelled rectangle
notes.tz: 页首方框：只是有标签的长方形
