cards.t: Website navigation: navigation bar and sitemap
cards.tz: 网站导航：导航栏与网站地图
cards.en:
Analogy: a navigation bar is like the exit signs in an MTR station: always visible, short words. A sitemap is like the directory board in a shopping mall: it lists every shop and floor.

Why: unclear navigation wastes visitors' time. Good navigation lets visitors find information quickly, improving user experience and keeping them on the site longer.

  • Navigation bar tips: lock it at the top of the page; few options; concise button text; clear font; buttons not too small (hard to click) or too large.
  • Sitemap: lists the sections of the website in detail, helping visitors and search engines locate information quickly.
  • Use hyperlinks properly (clear link text).

Exam wording: A navigation bar lets visitors quickly understand how information is arranged and move between pages; a sitemap lists all sections of the website to help visitors and search engines locate information quickly.
cards.zh:
比喻：导航栏像港铁站的出口指示牌：一直看得见、字简短。网站地图像商场的楼层目录：列出所有店铺。

原因：导航不清楚会浪费访客时间。好的导航令访客快速找到资料，改善用户体验，令他们留得更久。

  • 导航栏：固定在页面顶部；选项少；按钮文字简洁；字体清楚；按钮大小适中。
  • 网站地图：详细列出网站各部分，帮助访客和搜寻引擎快速找到资料。

考试写法：A navigation bar lets visitors quickly understand how information is arranged; a sitemap lists all sections of the website to help visitors and search engines locate information quickly.

ex.q: A shop's navigation bar has 18 buttons in tiny font. Suggest two improvements.
ex.a:
1. Group items into a few main categories (e.g. 5–7), with sub-menus.
2. Use a larger, clear font and bigger buttons that are easy to click.
3. (Also: lock the bar at the top.)
ex.az:
1. 归纳成少数主类别。
2. 字体和按钮加大。
3. 固定在顶部。

ex.q: How does a sitemap help a search engine?
ex.a:
1. It lists every section/page of the site with links.
2. The search engine can find and index all pages quickly.
3. So users can find the pages through search.
ex.az: 网站地图列出所有页面，搜寻引擎能快速找到并收录。

ex.q: A student puts the navigation bar only at the bottom of each long page. Problem?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Users must scroll to the end before they can move to another page.
2. Lock the navigation bar at the top (fixed) so it is always visible.
ex.az: 常见错误。访客要拉到底才可转页；导航栏应固定在顶部。

demo.html:
Home Products About Us Contact
Scroll down: the bar stays at the top.

code.src: Home Products Contact

notes.t: HTML5 element for the navigation bar
Short, clear button text linking to a page

code.src:
nav { position: sticky; top: 0; }
nav a { font-size: 18px; margin-right: 16px; }

notes.t: Lock the bar at the top while scrolling
notes.tz: 滚动时把导航栏固定在顶部

notes.t: Clear font, buttons spaced so they are easy to click
notes.tz: 字体清楚、按钮有间距、易点击

cards.tz: 跨平台与响应式网页设计
cards.en:
Analogy: water takes the shape of its cup. A responsive page takes the shape of the screen: wide on a computer, narrow on a phone.

  • Cross-platform design: the website works on different platforms, e.g. desktop computers and mobile devices. Most sites now share one URL for mobile and desktop and switch automatically.
  • Responsive web design: the content adapts to different screen sizes, platforms and orientations by resizing, hiding or rearranging elements (e.g. 3 columns on a PC → 1 column on a phone).
  • Benefits: looks good on all devices; saves hours of work creating multiple layouts.
  • Also: reduce image file size for mobile users.

Exam wording: Responsive web design makes web content adapt to different screen sizes, platforms and device orientations, so the site displays well on all devices without creating separate layouts.
cards.zh:
比喻：水会变成杯子的形状。响应式网页会变成屏幕的形状：电脑上宽，手机上窄。

  • 跨平台设计：网站可在桌面电脑和流动装置等不同平台运作，多数网站共用同一 URL，自动切换。
  • 响应式设计：内容按屏幕大小、平台、方向自动调整：缩放、隐藏或重新排列（电脑三栏 → 手机一栏）。
  • 好处：所有装置都好看，省去制作多个版面的时间。
  • 也要为手机用户缩小图片文件。

考试写法：Responsive web design makes web content adapt to different screen sizes, platforms and device orientations, so the site displays well on all devices without creating separate layouts.

ex.q: Janet wants to put large camera photos (8 MB each) on her responsive blog. What should she do?
ex.a:
1. Resize/compress the photos (e.g. to JPG ~200 KB) before uploading.
2. Mobile users load faster and use less data.
3. Use CSS like max-width:100% so images shrink to fit the screen.
ex.az: 上载前压缩缩小相片；用 max-width:100% 令图片适应屏幕。

ex.q: In the demo, what happens to the three boxes when the preview is narrower than 500px?
ex.a:
1. The CSS media query @media (max-width:500px) becomes true.
2. It sets flex-direction: column.
3. The boxes stack in one column instead of side by side.
ex.az: 宽度少于 500px 时，media query 生效，三个方框改为直排。

ex.q: A company makes a separate site m.shop.com for phones and copies every change by hand. A student says this is responsive design. Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Two separate sites = two layouts to maintain.
2. Responsive design is ONE page/URL whose layout adapts automatically.
3. It saves the work of updating multiple layouts.
ex.az: 常见错误。两个独立网站不是响应式；响应式是同一页面自动调整。

demo.html:
News
Events
Photos

Make the preview narrow (under 500px) to see the boxes stack.

notes.t: Put the boxes side by side
An image never gets wider than its container
Rules inside apply only when the screen is 500px wide or less
notes.tz: 以下规则只在屏幕 ≤500px 时生效

notes.t: On small screens, stack the boxes in one column

cards.en:
Analogy: a textbook page with headings, bullet points and diagrams is easier than one huge block of text. Web pages are the same.

Readability = how easy the content is to read and understand.

  • Use lists and tables instead of long paragraphs for complex information.
  • Include multimedia (pictures, audio, video, animation) to attract interest and explain ideas.
  • Font size and colour: use size, colour, position and font to emphasise key points; keep high contrast between text and background (e.g. dark text on light background); use a harmonious colour scheme suited to the purpose.
  • Avoid busy background pictures behind text.

Exam wording: Readability refers to the extent to which the content of a web page is easy to read and understand. It can be improved by using lists and tables, multimedia elements, suitable font sizes and high colour contrast between text and background.
cards.zh:
比喻：有标题、要点和图表的课本页，比一大段文字易读，网页也一样。

可读性 = 内容有多容易阅读和理解。

  • 用清单和表格代替长段落。
  • 加入多媒体（图片、音频、影片、动画）。
  • 字体大小和颜色：用大小、颜色、位置、字体突出重点；文字与背景要高对比；配色和谐、配合网站目的。
  • 文字后面不要放复杂背景图。

考试写法：Readability refers to the extent to which the content of a web page is easy to read and understand. It can be improved by using lists and tables, multimedia, suitable font sizes and high colour contrast between text and background.

ex.q: A page shows yellow text on a white background with a busy photo behind it. Improve readability.
ex.a:
1. Change to high contrast, e.g. dark blue/black text on white.
2. Remove the busy photo behind the text (or put it beside the text).
3. Use a larger font for key points.
ex.az: 改成高对比（深色字白底）；移走文字后的复杂图片；重点用较大字。

ex.q: A long paragraph compares the price, storage and battery of three phones. How can it be made more readable?
ex.a:
1. Put the data in a table: rows = phones, columns = price, storage, battery.
2. Readers can compare at a glance.
ex.az: 改用表格：行是手机，列是价钱、容量、电池，一眼比较。

ex.q: A student makes every word bold and red 'to emphasise everything'. Problem?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. If everything is emphasised, nothing stands out.
2. Emphasise only the key points; keep normal text plain.
ex.az: 常见错误。全部强调等于没有强调，只强调重点。

demo.html:
Low contrast: yellow on white is hard to read.

High contrast: dark text on a light background.

  • Price: $3,999
  • Storage: 256 GB

notes.t: Yellow text on white: low contrast, hard to read
Dark text on light grey: high contrast

cards.t: Colour schemes and the mood they create
cards.en:
Plain idea: colours set a feeling before anyone reads a word. Pick a harmonious scheme that suits the purpose of the site.

ColourAtmosphere (book Fig. 4.22)
Redenergetic, confident
Orangeyouthful, gentle
Yellowvital, optimistic
Greenpeaceful, growth
Bluetrustworthy, safe
Purpleelegant, magnificent
  • Professional sites (banks) often use blue; teaching/learning sites use lively colours.
  • Keep high contrast between text and background; avoid busy background pictures.
  • These are general practices; sometimes designers break the rules for creative effects.

Exam wording: Low colour contrast between text and background makes reading difficult, e.g. yellow text on an orange background.
cards.zh:
简单说：颜色在用户读字前就定下感觉。要选协调、适合网站目的的配色。

颜色气氛（课本图 4.22）
红有活力、自信
橙年轻、温和
黄朝气、乐观
绿平和、成长
蓝可信、安全
紫优雅、华丽
  • 专业网站（银行）常用蓝色；教学网站用活泼颜色。
  • 文字与背景要高对比；避免复杂背景图。
  • 这些只是一般做法，有时可打破常规做出创意效果。

考试写法：Low colour contrast between text and background makes reading difficult, e.g. yellow text on an orange background.

ex.q: A bank wants its site to feel safe and reliable. Main colour?
ex.a: Blue: it gives a trustworthy, safe feeling.
ex.az: 蓝色，给人可信、安全的感觉。

ex.q: A supermarket manager wants an orange background with yellow text to match the brand. Good idea? (Core Exercise)
ex.a: No. Orange and yellow have low contrast, so the text is hard to read.
ex.az: 不好。橙和黄对比低，字难读。

ex.q: Pick a colour for a meditation app's site and give a reason.
ex.a: Green: peaceful, calm feeling that fits relaxation.
ex.az: 绿色，平和，适合放松。

cards.en:
Analogy: a menu where you tick boxes is faster and has fewer mistakes than writing your order on a blank paper.

  • Drop-down list: choose one value from a list (district, branch).
  • Slider: choose a value in a range (price, volume).
  • Date picker: choose a date from a calendar.
  • ▲▼ buttons (number), radio buttons (one choice), checkboxes (many choices).
  • Text boxes are still needed for free information (name), but need validation.

Exam wording: Users can only select from specific values, which ensures that the data entered is within expectations and reduces input errors; it is also faster and easier, especially on touch screens.
cards.zh:
比喻：剔选格的餐牌比在白纸上写订单快，错误也少。

  • 下拉清单：从清单选一个（地区、分店）。
  • 滑杆：在范围内选数值（价钱、音量）。
  • 日期选择器：从日历选日期。
  • ▲▼ 按钮、单选按钮、复选框。
  • 文字框仍用于自由资料（姓名），但要验证。

考试写法：Users can only select from specific values, which ensures that the data entered is within expectations and reduces input errors; it is also faster and easier, especially on touch screens.

ex.q: A booking site uses a date picker instead of typing dates. Give two advantages. (Adapted from textbook Checkpoint)
ex.a:
1. Users can only pick valid dates, so there are no wrong formats (e.g. 31/02) → fewer input errors.
2. Faster and easier, especially on touch screens.
ex.az:
1. 只能选有效日期，减少错误。
2. 较快较方便，尤其触控屏。

ex.q: Choose the best input method: (a) district, (b) budget $0–$5000, (c) customer's name.
ex.a:
(a) Drop-down list (fixed set of districts).
(b) Slider (value in a range).
(c) Text box (free text) with validation.
ex.az: (a) 下拉清单；(b) 滑杆；(c) 文字框加验证。

ex.q: A student uses a drop-down list for 'Your name' with 500 common names. Good idea?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Names are free information; no list can cover them all.
2. Use a text box and validate it (e.g. not empty).
ex.az: 常见错误。姓名是自由资料，应用文字框并验证。

code.src:
<select><option>Central</option><option>Sha Tin</option></select>
<input type="range" min="0" max="5000" step="100">
<input type="date">
<input type="number" min="1" max="10" value="2">
<input type="text" placeholder="Tom Ho">

notes.t: Drop-down list: user picks one district
Slider from 0 to 5000 in steps of 100
Date picker: only valid dates can be chosen
notes.tz: 日期选择器：只能选有效日期

notes.t: Number box with ▲▼ buttons, range 1 to 10
Text box for free information (needs validation)
notes.tz: 文字框，输入自由资料（要验证）

cards.t: Exam-style input design: dates, ▲▼ buttons and kiosk layouts
cards.tz: 考试式输入设计：日期、▲▼ 按钮与自助机版面
cards.en:
Plain idea: DSE often shows two input designs and asks why one is better, or asks you to sketch a screen. Answer with fewer input errors and faster, easier input.

  • Date pickers / drop-downs (Example 4.1): the date must exist (no '31 February'), and the range is logical (check-in before check-out).
  • ▲▼ quantity buttons (DSE 2020 1B Q4b): minimise input errors and improve input efficiency.
  • Many items (30 sushi): arrange them sensibly (e.g. by popularity), show a few per sub-page, give clear quantity buttons.
  • Search form (railway): ask only what is needed (start point, destination); show results clearly (platform, train no., departure, arrival).

Exam wording: Users can only select from valid values, which reduces input errors and shortens input time. A drop-down list does not use a check digit and does not raise the character limit.
cards.zh:
简单说：DSE 常给两种输入设计问哪个好，或要你画画面。答减少输入错误和输入更快更方便。

  • 日期选择器／下拉选单（例 4.1）：日期一定存在（不会有 2 月 31 日），范围合理（入住早于退房）。
  • ▲▼ 数量按钮：减少输入错误、提高输入效率。
  • 项目很多（30 款寿司）：合理排列（如按受欢迎程度），每个子页显示几项，提供清楚的数量按钮。
  • 搜寻表格（铁路）：只问需要的（起点、终点）；清楚显示结果（月台、车号、开出、到达时间）。

考试写法：Users can only select from valid values, which reduces input errors and shortens input time. A drop-down list does not use a check digit and does not raise the character limit.

ex.q: Why is a day/month/year drop-down better than typing a date into a text box?
ex.a:
1. Only real dates can be chosen (no Feb 31).
2. The system can make the end date later than the start date.
3. Fewer typing errors.
ex.az: 只能选真实日期；可确保结束日期晚于开始日期；少打错。

ex.q: A time picker replaces a text box. Benefits: (1) check digit detects errors (2) fewer input errors (3) more convenient. Which?
ex.a: (2) and (3) only. A picker has nothing to do with a check digit.
ex.az: 只有 (2)(3)，与检查码无关。

ex.q: Railway search page: which inputs should the user enter? Start, destination, fare, number of exits.
ex.a: Start point and destination only. Fare is calculated by the system; exits are not needed for searching.
ex.az: 只需起点和终点；车费由系统计算。

cards.en:
Analogy: a building with ramps, lifts and braille signs can be used by everyone. An accessible website is the online version.

Web accessibility design makes the information on a website accessible to everyone, including people with visual impairment, hearing impairment and physical disability. It is a social responsibility and also attracts more users.

  • Font size options: visitors can enlarge text.
  • Alternative text (alt) for images: screen readers cannot interpret images on their own; alt text lets them read out a description.
  • High colour contrast; don't use colour alone to show meaning.
  • Captions/subtitles for videos (hearing impaired).
  • Multi-language content for ethnic minorities.
  • Keyboard navigation for people who cannot use a mouse.

Exam wording: Web accessibility design makes the information on a website accessible to everyone, including people with visual impairment, hearing impairment and physical disability, e.g. by providing alternative text for images, font size options and captions.
cards.zh:
比喻：有斜道、升降机和点字的大厦人人都能用，无障碍网站就是网上版。

无障碍网页设计令所有人都能取得网站资料，包括视障、听障和肢体伤残人士。这是社会责任，也吸引更多用户。

  • 字体大小选项。
  • 图片的 alt 替代文字：屏幕阅读器不能自行理解图片，alt 让它读出描述。
  • 高颜色对比。
  • 影片字幕（听障）。
  • 多语言内容（少数族裔）。
  • 键盘导航（不能用鼠标的人）。

考试写法：Web accessibility design makes the information on a website accessible to everyone, including people with visual impairment, hearing impairment and physical disability, e.g. by providing alternative text for images, font size options and captions.

ex.q: Which features help a blind user browse a government site?
ex.a:
1. Alt text on every image, so the screen reader can describe it.
2. Clear headings and link text that make sense when read aloud.
3. Keyboard navigation (no mouse needed).
ex.az: 每张图片有 alt；标题和连结文字清楚；可用键盘操作。

ex.q: Suggest one feature for users with hearing impairment.
ex.a: Provide captions/subtitles (or transcripts) for videos and audio.
ex.az: 影片和音频提供字幕或文字稿。

ex.q: A student writes alt="image1.png" for a photo of the school hall. Problem?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. A screen reader would read 'image1.png', which tells the user nothing.
2. Alt text should describe the image: alt="Students at the school hall assembly".
ex.az: 常见错误。alt 应描述图片内容，不是文件名。

demo.html:
This text can be resized for users with low vision.

Tab key works here: press Tab to move between links and buttons.

notes.t: Font size option: makes all text larger
notes.tz: 字体大小选项：放大全部文字

notes.t: Meaningful alt text that a screen reader can read out
notes.tz: 屏幕阅读器可读出的有意义替代文字

notes.t: Video with a captions track for hearing-impaired users
notes.tz: 影片附字幕轨，方便听障人士

cards.en:
Analogy: a good shop is fast to enter, looks the same in every branch, suits its customers, has fresh goods and a clear phone number. A good website is similar.

  • Loading speed: compress/resize images (e.g. convert BMP to JPG to reduce file size); avoid unnecessary large videos.
  • Consistency: same layout, colours and navigation on every page.
  • Target audience: elderly → large font, large buttons, simple navigation; children → bright pictures.
  • Up-to-date, correct content; check for broken links before publishing.
  • Copyright: only use images and media you have the right to use.
  • Contact information and a privacy statement.

Exam wording: Images should be compressed (e.g. converted from BMP to JPG) to reduce file size and shorten loading time; pages should keep a consistent layout and suit the target audience.

Book's ways to shorten loading time: (1) replace large images with thumbnails and let users choose to load the original; (2) reduce multimedia file sizes, e.g. lossy compressed formats and lower quality; (3) use images, video or audio only when appropriate. Keeping content concise helps users focus and loads faster. Also: if a photo is too large the page takes longer to load, so reduce the photo size to fit the display (DSE 2012 1A Q21).
cards.zh:
比喻：好的商店：入门快、每间分店一样、适合顾客、货品新鲜、有清楚电话。好网站也一样。

  • 载入速度：压缩图片（如 BMP 转 JPG 减小文件）；避免不必要的大影片。
  • 一致性：每页版面、颜色、导航相同。
  • 目标用户：长者 → 大字大按钮、导航简单；儿童 → 鲜艳图片。
  • 内容正确、最新；发布前检查失效连结。
  • 版权：只用有权使用的图片和媒体。
  • 联络资料和私隐声明。

考试写法：Images should be compressed (e.g. converted from BMP to JPG) to reduce file size and shorten loading time; pages should keep a consistent layout and suit the target audience.

课本缩短载入时间的方法：(1) 用缩图（thumbnail）代替大图，让用户自己选择是否载入原图；(2) 减小多媒体文件，如用有损压缩格式、降低质量；(3) 只在适当时才用图片、影片、声音。内容简洁既易专注又载入快。照片太大会令网页载入慢，应把照片缩小到适合显示的尺寸。

ex.q: James converts an image from BMP to JPG. What is the main reason?
ex.a:
1. BMP is uncompressed, so the file is large.
2. JPG is compressed → much smaller file.
3. The page loads faster.
ex.az: BMP 没压缩，JPG 压缩后文件小，网页载入快。

ex.q: An 800×600 24-bit BMP is about how big? Why is that a problem?
ex.a:
1. 800 × 600 = 480,000 pixels.
2. 24 bits = 3 bytes per pixel → 1,440,000 bytes ≈ 1.4 MB.
3. Several such images make the page slow on mobile data. A JPG may be ~100 KB.
ex.az: 800×600×3 字节 ≈ 1.4 MB，太大，手机载入慢；JPG 可能只有约 100 KB。

ex.q: A student copies a photo from a news website for the club page because 'it is on the Internet so it is free'. Correct?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Images on the Internet are usually protected by copyright.
2. Use your own photos, copyright-free images, or get permission.
ex.az: 常见错误。网上图片通常有版权，要用自己的、免版权的，或取得许可。

ex.q: A gallery page shows 40 full-size 5 MB photos and loads very slowly. Suggest one fix from the book.
ex.a: Show small thumbnails; the full photo loads only when the user clicks one.
ex.az: 先显示缩图，用户点击才载入原图。

cards.en:
Analogy: Wix is like a ready-made cake shop: you choose a cake base (template), add decorations (drag-and-drop), then put it in the shop window (publish) for everyone to see.

Wix is an easy-to-use drag-and-drop web design tool that provides free web hosting, so others can browse your pages on the Internet.

  1. Go to Wix, click Get Started; log in or register.
  2. Create New Site → choose a template or Blank Template → Edit.
  3. Click Add → embed an HTML code widget; drag to position and resize.
  4. Enter Code → type HTML → Apply to preview.
  5. Menus and Pages → Rename to set the page title; add more pages.
  6. Save, then Publish to get the site URL.

Exam wording: Wix is a drag-and-drop web authoring tool that provides free web hosting; the website must be published before others can access it through its URL.

Publishing (Lab 4.4): preview and test before publishing. After Save, click Publish → View Site. Edits after publishing are not updated automatically: save and republish. In the dashboard, Site Actions → Rename Site changes the site name and the URL, e.g. ictlabdemo.wixsite.com/my-site (page title, website name and URL are different things).
cards.zh:
比喻：Wix 像现成蛋糕店：选蛋糕底（模板）、加装饰（拖放），再放进橱窗（发布）给人看。

Wix 是易用的拖放式网页设计工具，并提供免费网页寄存，令别人可在互联网浏览。

  1. 到 Wix 按 Get Started，登入或注册。
  2. Create New Site → 选模板或 Blank Template → Edit。
  3. Add → 嵌入 HTML code 小工具，拖放调整位置大小。
  4. Enter Code → 输入 HTML → Apply 预览。
  5. Menus and Pages → Rename 改页面标题、加页面。
  6. Save，然后 Publish 取得网址。

考试写法：Wix is a drag-and-drop web authoring tool that provides free web hosting; the website must be published before others can access it through its URL.

发布（Lab 4.4）：发布前先预览和测试。Save 后按 Publish → View Site。发布后再修改不会自动更新，要储存后重新发布。在 dashboard 用 Site Actions → Rename Site 改网站名称和网址，如 ictlabdemo.wixsite.com/my-site（页面标题、网站名、URL 是三样不同的东西）。

ex.q: After editing, Amy clicks Save and closes Wix without clicking Publish. Can her friends see the new site?
ex.a:
Common mistake: Save ≠ Publish.
1. Save only stores the draft in her account.
2. Only Publish puts it online and gives a public URL.
3. Her friends cannot see it yet.
ex.az: 常见错误：储存不等于发布。Save 只储存草稿，要 Publish 才上线。

ex.q: Amy wants to paste her own HTML table into a Wix page. Which steps?
ex.a:
1. Add → Embed → HTML code widget.
2. Drag/resize the widget to the right place.
3. Enter Code → paste the table HTML → Apply to preview.
4. Save and Publish.
ex.az: Add → HTML code 小工具 → 拖放 → Enter Code 贴上 → Apply → Save → Publish。

ex.q: State one advantage and one disadvantage of using Wix free hosting for a class project.
ex.a:
1. Advantage: free, no need to set up a server, drag-and-drop is easy.
2. Disadvantage: limited storage/speed, Wix ads and a long URL containing the provider's name.
ex.az: 好处：免费、不用自己架服务器、易用；坏处：容量速度有限、有广告、网址含 Wix。

ex.q: Ben edits his published Wix site and saves, but friends still see the old page. Why?
ex.a: Saving only updates the draft. He must click Publish again (republish) to update the live website.
ex.az: 只储存了草稿，要再按 Publish 重新发布。

frames.en: Open Wix, click Get Started, log in or register.
frames.zh: 打开 Wix，按 Get Started，登入或注册。

frames.en: Choose a template or Blank Template, then Edit.
frames.zh: 选模板或 Blank Template，然后 Edit。

frames.en: Add → Embed → HTML code widget; drag to place and resize.
frames.zh: Add → HTML code 小工具，拖放调整。

frames.en: Type or paste HTML, click Apply to preview it.
frames.zh: 输入 HTML，按 Apply 预览。

frames.en: Rename the page title; add more pages.
frames.zh: 改页面标题、加页面。

frames.en: Save keeps the draft; Publish puts it on the Internet and gives the URL.
frames.zh: Save 储存草稿；Publish 才上线并得到网址。

cards.en:
Analogy: free hosting is like a free market stall: small, crowded, with the organiser's banner on it. Paid hosting is renting your own shop: more space, more customers at once, your own name above the door.

Web hosting = storing website files on a server connected to the Internet so others can visit.

Free hostingPaid hosting
Storage / speedLimitedMore storage, faster
Visitors at onceFewMany
URLContains provider's name, e.g. tom.wixsite.com/clubOwn domain, e.g. www.myclub.hk
AdsOftenNone
Cost$0Monthly/yearly fee

Choose by: expected traffic, budget, storage needs, need for a custom domain.

Exam wording: Free web hosting providers usually limit storage space and browsing speed. Purchasing a hosting plan allows a large number of users to visit at the same time and increases storage space and speed.
cards.zh:
比喻：免费寄存像免费市集摊位：细、挤、挂主办方横额；付费寄存像租自己的铺：地方大、可容纳更多客、门口挂自己名字。

网页寄存 = 把网站文件放在连接互联网的服务器上。

  • 免费：容量和速度有限；同时访客少；网址含供应商名称；常有广告。
  • 付费：容量大、速度快；可容纳大量同时访客；可用自己的域名（www.myclub.hk）；没有广告；要付月费/年费。

考试写法：Free web hosting providers usually limit storage space and browsing speed. Purchasing a hosting plan allows a large number of users to visit at the same time and increases storage space and speed.

ex.q: A school club expects 2000 visitors during its online sale week. Free or paid hosting?
ex.a:
1. Many visitors at the same time.
2. Free hosting limits speed/traffic → the site may be slow or down.
3. Choose paid hosting (at least for that period).
ex.az: 访客多，免费寄存速度有限，应选付费。

ex.q: A student's personal portfolio gets about 10 visits a week and has no budget. Which hosting?
ex.a:
1. Low traffic, small storage, no budget.
2. Free hosting is enough.
ex.az: 流量少、没预算 → 免费寄存已足够。

ex.q: A student says 'free hosting lets me use my own domain www.tomho.com for free.' Usually true?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. Free plans normally give a sub-address with the provider's name (e.g. tomho.wixsite.com/site).
2. A custom domain usually needs a paid plan (plus buying the domain).
ex.az: 常见错误。免费计划通常只给含供应商名称的网址，自订域名一般要付费。

ex.q: Which tag puts text on the browser tab, and where does it go?
ex.a: <title>, inside <head>.
ex.az: <title>，放在 <head>。

ex.q: Write a link that jumps to the anchor 'top' on the same page.
ex.a: <a href="#top">Back to top</a>
ex.az: <a href="#top">Back to top</a>。

ex.q: A student writes <td colspan=2 rowspan="2"> and thinks it fills 2 cells. How many grid positions does it really cover?
ex.a:
Common mistake.
1. colspan 2 × rowspan 2 = 4 positions (2 columns × 2 rows).
2. The next row must leave out 2 <td>s for it.
ex.az: 常见错误。2 列 × 2 行 = 4 个位置，下一行要少写两个 td。

mc.q: Which technology describes the structure of a web page?
mc.e: HTML uses markups to describe structure.

mc.q: Which technology adds interactive behaviour such as responding to a button click?
mc.e: JavaScript is a programming language that adds dynamic programs.

mc.q: Which statement about HTML is correct?
o: It is a cross-platform markup language
It is a programming language with loops
mc.e: HTML is a cross-platform markup language, not a programming language.
mc.ez: HTML 是跨平台标示语言。

mc.q: What is the main advantage of using CSS for a multi-page website?
o: One style can be applied to many pages at once
mc.e: A shared style updates all pages, easier maintenance.

sq.q: Peter is learning how a web page is built.

parts.q: State the role of HTML, CSS and JavaScript in a web page.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: HTML uses markups to describe the structure/content of the page [1]
CSS describes the appearance/style of HTML elements [1]
JavaScript adds dynamic/interactive programs [1]

parts.q: Peter says 'HTML is a programming language'. Do you agree? Explain.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Disagree [1]
HTML only defines elements of a page; it has no programming constructs like variables, selection or loops [1]

parts.q: Give ONE advantage of using CSS for a website with many pages.
parts.ms: Suggested answer: One style can be applied to all pages at once, making creation/maintenance easier and consistent [1]

sq.q:
Write HTML code for the following.
A page titled 'ICT Club' shows a red level-1 heading 'Welcome', a centred paragraph 'Join us every Friday', and an image club.png 150 pixels high with alternative text 'club photo'.

parts.q: Write the complete HTML document.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Correct DOCTYPE/html/head/body skeleton [1]
<title>ICT Club</title> inside head [1]
<h1 style="color:red">Welcome</h1> [1]
<p style="text-align:center">Join us every Friday</p> [1]
<img src="club.png" alt="club photo" height="150"> [1]

parts.q: Where will 'ICT Club' be displayed?
parts.ms: Suggested answer: On the browser tab / title bar [1]

parts.q: State TWO purposes of the alt attribute.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Displayed when the image cannot be loaded [1]
Read aloud by screen readers for visually impaired users [1]

parts.q: How many rows and columns does the table display?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: 3 rows [1]
3 columns [1]

parts.q: Explain the effect of colspan="3" and rowspan="2".
parts.ms:

'Mon' cell spans rows 2 and 3 in column 1 [1]

<a name="fees">...</a> (or id="fees") [1]

parts.q: Explain the meaning of #RRGGBB.

each pair 00–FF (0–255) [1]

parts.q: What colours are #0000FF and #FFFF00?
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Blue [1]
Yellow [1]

parts.q: Write code for a paragraph with white text on a black background.
parts.ms: Suggested answer: style="color:#FFFFFF [1]; background-color:#000000" [1]

sq.q: A cooking school plans a website with a homepage, course pages for 6 cuisines (each with 3 sub-pages) and a 12-step online lesson.

parts.q: Suggest a suitable structure for the course section and for the online lesson. Explain.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Course section: hierarchical [1], homepage branches into cuisines then sub-pages, easy to organise categories [1]
Lesson: linear [1], steps must be followed in order with Next/Previous [1]

parts.q: State ONE drawback of a matrix structure.
parts.ms: Suggested answer: Users may get lost / confusing without clear navigation [1]

sq.q: A charity is building a website for the elderly and ethnic minorities.

parts.q: Distinguish UI and UX.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: UI: graphic design and appearance (buttons, icons, colours) [1]
UX: users' impression and overall experience of using the site [1]

parts.q: Suggest FOUR design features for these users and explain.
parts.ms:
Suggested answer: Font size adjusting function for poor eyesight [1]
Large buttons/simple navigation bar for easy clicking [1]
High colour contrast for readability [1]
Multi-language content to reduce language barriers [1] (also alt text, concise structure)

parts.q: Why should a wireframe be drawn first?

sec: 5.2 Effective Measures to Improve Network Security

cards.en:
Analogy: malware is like a burglar who gets into your home. Different burglars use different tricks: one hides in a parcel, one walks in by himself, one pretends to be a repairman.

What it is: malware = malicious software, programs written to do harm.

Six types in the syllabus: virus, worm, Trojan program, spyware, adware, ransomware. Tell them apart with 3 questions:

TypeNeeds host file?Self-replicates?Main goal
VirusYesYesDamage files
WormNoYes (via network)Spread, use up resources
TrojanLooks like a useful appNoBackdoor, remote control
Spyware-NoSteal personal data
Adware-NoShow ads for money
Ransomware-Some spread like wormsEncrypt files, ask for ransom

Protection is in layers: antivirus, firewall, software updates, care with email/downloads, regular backup.

Exam wording: Malware refers to programs that can damage computer functions, steal user data, gain unauthorised access, or attack networks. Always name the type AND describe its behaviour.
cards.zh:
比喻：恶意软件像小偷，各有手法：有的躲在包裹里，有的自己走进来，有的扮维修工。

定义：malware = malicious software，为了造成伤害而写的程式。

考纲六种：virus、worm、Trojan program、spyware、adware、ransomware。用三个问题分辨：

类型需要宿主文件？自我复制？目的
Virus要会破坏文件
Worm不要会（经网络）扩散、耗尽资源
Trojan伪装成有用程式不会后门、遥控
Spyware-不会偷个人资料
Adware-不会显示广告赚钱
Ransomware-部分像 worm 扩散加密文件勒索

防护要多层：防毒软件、防火墙、更新、小心电邮/下载、定期备份。

考试写法：Malware refers to programs that can damage computer functions, steal user data, gain unauthorised access, or attack networks. 答题要写出类型和具体行为。

ex.q: A program shows pop-up ads and secretly records the websites the user visits. Classify it.
ex.a:
1. Shows ads for profit → adware.
2. Secretly collects browsing data → spyware.
3. So it is both; one program can belong to two types.
ex.az:
1. 弹广告 → adware。
2. 偷偷记录浏览 → spyware。
3. 一个程式可同时属两类。

ex.q: Which type(s) self-replicate: virus, worm, Trojan?
ex.a:
1. Virus copies itself into other files → yes.
2. Worm copies itself across the network → yes.
3. Trojan relies on tricking the user → no.
Answer: virus and worm.
ex.az: virus 和 worm 会自我复制；Trojan 不会。

ex.q: A student writes: 'The computer got a virus, so the hacker could control it remotely.' What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Remote control through a backdoor is the typical behaviour of a Trojan program, not a virus.
2. 'Virus' is not a general word for all malware in the exam.
3. Better: 'A Trojan program created a backdoor, allowing the hacker to gain remote control.'
ex.az: 常见错误：把所有恶意软件都叫 virus。遥控/后门是 Trojan 的特征，要写准确类型。

cards.t: Hackers: black hat and white hat
cards.en:
Plain idea: a hacker is someone who breaks into another person's computer or system. What matters is permission and purpose.

Black hat hackerWhite hat hacker
Legal?No, a cyber criminalYes, with permission
DoesAttacks and breaks into systems, steals data for illegal benefitSecurity testing: attacks systems to find security bugs
Works forThemselves / criminalsNetwork security companies, organisations

Exam wording: White hat hackers legally attack computer systems to look for security bugs, helping organisations improve network security.
cards.zh:
简单说：黑客是入侵别人电脑或系统的人。关键是有没有授权、目的是什么。

黑帽黑客白帽黑客
合法？否，是网络罪犯是，有授权
做什么攻击入侵系统，偷数据谋取非法利益安全测试：攻击系统找安全漏洞
为谁工作自己／犯罪集团网络保安公司、机构

考试写法：White hat hackers legally attack computer systems to look for security bugs, helping organisations improve network security.

ex.q: A bank hires Ada to attack its own website and report weak points. Which type?
ex.a: White hat: legal, with permission, to improve security.
ex.az: 白帽：合法、有授权、为改善保安。

ex.q: Ben breaks into a shop's database and sells the card numbers. Which type?
ex.a: Black hat: illegal access for profit, a cyber criminal.
ex.az: 黑帽：非法入侵谋利。

ex.q: 'All hackers are criminals.' Correct?
ex.a: No. White hat hackers are legally employed to test security.
ex.az: 错，白帽黑客是合法受雇测试保安的。

cards.en:
Analogy: a real virus cannot live alone; it needs a body (host). A computer virus is the same: it needs a host file.

How it works:

  1. The virus attaches itself to an executable file (.exe) or a document.
  2. The file is copied around (USB, email attachment, download).
  3. The user runs the file → the virus activates.
  4. It damages files and copies itself into other files.

Three key points: needs a host file; activated by the user's action; self-replicates.

Effects: corrupted/deleted files, slow or strange system. Prevention: scan files before opening, keep antivirus updated, do not run programs from unknown sources.

Exam wording: A virus attaches itself to executable files or documents. Once the user executes the program, the virus attacks the files and other data in the computer and replicates itself.
cards.zh:
比喻：真正的病毒不能独立生存，要寄生在身体（宿主）上。电脑病毒也一样，需要宿主文件 (host file)。

运作：

  1. 病毒依附在 .exe 或文件上。
  2. 文件经 USB、电邮附件、下载被复制。
  3. 用户执行文件 → 病毒启动。
  4. 破坏文件，并复制自己到其他文件。

三个重点：要宿主文件；由用户动作启动；会自我复制。

影响：文件损坏/删除、系统变慢。预防：开启前扫描、更新防毒软件、不执行来历不明程式。

考试写法：A virus attaches itself to executable files or documents. Once the user executes the program, the virus attacks the files and other data in the computer and replicates itself.

ex.q: Peter copies game.exe from a friend's USB. After running it, many .exe files grow in size and crash. Which malware? Why?
ex.a:
1. It came attached to game.exe → needs a host file.
2. It started only after Peter ran it → activated by user.
3. Other .exe files changed → it replicated into them.
Answer: a virus.
ex.az: 依附 exe、执行后发作、感染其他 exe → virus。

ex.q: An infected file sits in a folder and is never opened. Is the computer harmed yet?
ex.a:
1. A virus is activated by the user executing the host.
2. Not opened → not activated yet.
3. But it is still dangerous: someone may open it later, so scan and delete it.
ex.az: 未执行就未启动，但仍要扫描删除。

ex.q: A student writes: 'A virus spreads by itself to other computers through the network.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. That describes a worm.
2. A virus needs a host file and a user action; it spreads when infected files are copied/shared.
3. Correct: 'A virus spreads when the infected host file is copied and executed on another computer.'
ex.az: 常见错误：virus 不会自己经网络扩散，那是 worm。virus 要靠被复制的宿主文件和用户执行。

frames.en: The virus is attached to game.exe on a USB drive.
frames.zh: 病毒依附在 USB 里的 game.exe。

frames.en: The user double-clicks game.exe. This activates the virus.
frames.zh: 用户执行 game.exe，病毒启动。

frames.en: The virus copies itself into other .exe files on the PC.
frames.zh: 病毒复制到电脑其他 .exe。

frames.en: Files become corrupted; the system slows down.
frames.zh: 文件损坏、系统变慢。

cards.en:
Analogy: a virus is a passenger that needs a car (host file). A worm is a car that drives itself.

How it works:

  1. A user opens an infected email attachment once.
  2. The worm reads the address book.
  3. It emails copies of itself to every contact automatically.
  4. Each new victim's computer does the same → fast spread.

Example: ILOVEYOU sent up to 300 emails from each infected computer. People trusted mail from known contacts, so they opened it.

Effects: uses up network bandwidth and system resources. Prevention: do not open unknown attachments, spam filter, patch the OS, firewall.

Exam wording: A worm is self-replicating malware that does not need to be attached to any file and can spread to other computers on the network by itself.
cards.zh:
比喻：virus 像乘客，要搭车（宿主文件）；worm 像自动驾驶的车，自己走。

运作：

  1. 用户打开受感染的电邮附件一次。
  2. Worm 读取通讯录。
  3. 自动把自己寄给所有联络人。
  4. 每个新受害者重复 → 极速扩散。

例：ILOVEYOU 每部电脑可发 300 封。邮件来自熟人，收件人戒心低。

影响：耗尽频宽和系统资源。预防：不开陌生附件、垃圾邮件过滤、更新 OS、防火墙。

考试写法：A worm is self-replicating malware that does not need to be attached to any file and can spread to other computers on the network by itself.

ex.q: Why did the ILOVEYOU worm spread so rapidly?
ex.a:
1. It emailed itself automatically to all contacts (self-replicates through the network).
2. Emails came from known contacts, so people trusted them.
3. The attractive subject made people open the attachment.
ex.az: 自动寄给全部联络人＋来自熟人＋吸引的标题。

ex.q: A worm sends itself to 50 contacts from each infected PC, and each of them opens it. Starting from 1 PC, how many PCs are infected after 2 rounds?
ex.a:
1. Round 1: 1 PC infects 50 → 1 + 50 = 51.
2. Round 2: each of the 50 infects 50 → 50 × 50 = 2500 new.
3. Total = 51 + 2500 = 2551. This shows why worms spread exponentially.
ex.az: 第一轮 51 部，第二轮再加 2500 部，共 2551 部，呈指数增长。

ex.q: A student writes: 'A worm and a virus are the same because both self-replicate.' What is missing?
ex.a:
1. Both self-replicate, but that is not enough.
2. Key difference: a worm needs no host file and spreads through the network by itself; a virus needs a host file and user execution.
3. Write the difference, not only the similarity.
ex.az: 常见错误：只写相同点。要写分别：worm 不需宿主文件、自行经网络扩散。

frames.en: Ann opens an infected attachment. The worm starts on her PC.
frames.zh: Ann 打开附件，worm 在她电脑启动。

frames.en: The worm reads Ann's address book: Ben, Cat, Dan.
frames.zh: Worm 读取通讯录。

frames.en: It emails itself to all of them automatically. No host file needed.
frames.zh: 自动寄出副本，不需宿主文件。

frames.en: Each new victim sends it to their own contacts. Network bandwidth is used up.
frames.zh: 每个受害者再寄出，频宽被耗尽。

cards.en:
Analogy: in the Greek story, soldiers hid inside a wooden horse that looked like a gift. A Trojan program looks like a useful app, but hides something bad.

How it works:

  1. It looks useful (free game, cracked software, 'speed booster').
  2. The user is tricked into installing it.
  3. It opens a backdoor (a secret way in).
  4. The hacker uses the backdoor to remotely control the device, steal files and watch network activity.

Key difference: a Trojan does not self-replicate. It depends on fooling the user.

Prevention: download only from official stores/websites, check the publisher and reviews, scan installers.

Exam wording: A Trojan program disguises itself as a useful application to lure users into installing it. It may create a backdoor that allows hackers to gain remote control of the computer.

Book comparison (Table 5.1):

Self-replicationAttached to other programsSpreads on networks by itself
Virus✓✓✗
Worm✓✗✓
Trojan✗✗✗

Activity 5.2: scam apps on app stores passed review, then added malicious code through updates. Check whether the permissions an app asks for are reasonable (e.g. a wallpaper app asking for SMS logs is a warning sign); download only from official or reputable sources.
cards.zh:
比喻：希腊故事里，士兵躲在像礼物的木马里。木马程式看似有用，其实藏有恶意。

运作：

  1. 伪装成有用程式（免费游戏、破解软件、“加速器”）。
  2. 用户被骗安装。
  3. 建立后门 (backdoor)。
  4. 黑客经后门遥控设备、偷文件、监察网络活动。

关键：Trojan 不会自我复制，靠欺骗用户。

预防：只在官方下载、检查发行者及评价、安装前扫描。

考试写法：A Trojan program disguises itself as a useful application to lure users into installing it. It may create a backdoor that allows hackers to gain remote control of the computer.

课本比较（表 5.1）：病毒：会自我复制、依附其他程序；蠕虫：会自我复制、可自行在网络传播；木马：三样都不会。

活动 5.2：应用商店的诈骗 app 先通过审核，再经更新植入恶意代码。要检查 app 要求的权限是否合理（墙纸 app 要读 SMS 就可疑）；只从官方或可靠来源下载。

ex.q: Which threats exist on a computer infected by a Trojan? (1) files stolen (2) remote control (3) copies itself to all contacts
ex.a:
1. Backdoor → files can be stolen: (1) yes.
2. Backdoor → remote control: (2) yes.
3. Trojans do not self-replicate: (3) is a worm.
Answer: (1) and (2) only.
ex.az: 木马不会自我复制，(3) 是 worm。

ex.q: Tom downloads a 'free full version' photo editor from an unknown forum. It works, but his webcam light turns on by itself. Explain.
ex.a:
1. The editor was disguised as useful software → Trojan.
2. It opened a backdoor.
3. The hacker remotely controls the webcam through the backdoor.
ex.az: 伪装有用软件 → Trojan，经后门遥控镜头。

ex.q: A student writes: 'Trojans are safe if the program works normally.' Why is this wrong?
ex.a:
1. A Trojan is designed to look and work like a normal program so the user does not suspect it.
2. The harmful part (backdoor) runs secretly in the background.
3. Working normally proves nothing; the source and a scan matter.
ex.az: 常见错误：程式能正常用不代表安全。木马故意伪装正常，后门在背景运作。

ex.q: A wallpaper app asks for access to SMS logs and notifications. What should you suspect?
ex.a: It may be a Trojan/scam app: the permissions are unrelated to its job. Deny or do not install.
ex.az: 权限与功能无关，可能是木马，应拒绝或不安装。

frames.en: A 'free game' installer is offered on an unofficial site.
frames.zh: 非官方网站提供“免费游戏”。

frames.en: The user installs it. The game works, but a backdoor is opened.
frames.zh: 用户安装，游戏能玩，但后门已开。

frames.en: The hacker connects through the backdoor and controls the PC, steals files.
frames.zh: 黑客经后门遥控、偷文件。

cards.en:
Analogy: spyware is a hidden camera in your room. Adware is a salesman who keeps knocking on your door.

Spyware: steals personal data such as browsing history, passwords, even every key you press (keylogging). It hides and does not visibly damage the system. Data is used to steal money or is sold.

Adware: makes money by showing ads (pop-ups, banners). Some adware is also spyware: it collects data to target ads.

SpywareAdware
GoalSteal informationShow ads for profit
Visible?HidesVery visible (pop-ups)

Symptoms: many pop-ups, home page/search engine changed, unknown toolbars, slow PC. Fix: anti-spyware scan, remove suspicious browser plug-ins.

Exam wording: Spyware's main purpose is to steal the user's personal information, such as account passwords and keyboard input, while hiding to avoid being noticed. Adware profits from displaying advertisements.

Book's warning signs: the browser's default homepage is changed; new pages appear in Favourites; new software such as browser toolbars is installed; ads keep popping up in new windows and tabs. Spyware is usually installed with freeware.
cards.zh:
比喻：spyware 像房里的隐藏镜头；adware 像不停敲门的推销员。

Spyware：偷个人资料：浏览纪录、密码、甚至每个按键（keylogging）。会隐藏，不明显破坏系统。资料用来盗款或转售。

Adware：靠显示广告赚钱（弹窗、横幅）。部分 adware 同时是 spyware，收集资料投放广告。

SpywareAdware
目的偷资料广告获利
明显吗？隐藏很明显（弹窗）

症状：大量弹窗、首页/搜寻器被改、不明工具列、电脑变慢。处理：反间谍扫描、移除可疑插件。

考试写法：Spyware's main purpose is to steal the user's personal information, such as account passwords and keyboard input, while hiding to avoid being noticed. Adware profits from displaying advertisements.

课本列出的征兆：浏览器预设首页被改；「我的最爱」多了网页；装了新软件如浏览器工具列；广告不断在新视窗／分页弹出。

ex.q: Mary's bank password was stolen, though she told no one and her PC shows no damage. Which malware?
ex.a:
1. Password stolen → information theft.
2. No visible damage → it hides.
3. Answer: spyware, likely a keylogger recording keyboard input.
ex.az: 无明显破坏但密码被偷 → spyware/keylogger。

ex.q: After installing a free PDF tool, Leo's browser home page changes and ads pop up everywhere. Which malware? Give one action.
ex.a:
1. Ads everywhere → adware (bundled with freeware).
2. Action: uninstall the tool / remove the suspicious plug-in, then run an antivirus scan.
ex.az: 弹广告 → adware；移除插件并扫描。

ex.q: A student writes: 'There are no pop-ups, so my PC has no spyware.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. Pop-ups are a sign of adware.
2. Spyware is designed to hide, so no symptoms may be visible.
3. Run an anti-spyware scan to check.
ex.az: 常见错误：没有弹窗≠没有 spyware。spyware 会隐藏，要扫描。

cards.en:
Analogy: a thief puts a lock on your cupboard and says 'pay me for the key'.

How it works:

  1. Ransomware gets in (attachment, unpatched bug).
  2. It encrypts your files: they become unreadable.
  3. A message demands a ransom (often Bitcoin) for the decryption key.
  4. If you do not pay in time, the price rises or files are deleted.

Example: WannaCry (2017) used 'Eternal Blue' (a tool stolen from the US NSA) to exploit an unpatched Windows bug and spread like a worm.

If infected: do not pay (no guarantee, funds crime); disconnect from the network; report to police; restore from backup.

Prevention: regular offline backup, update OS, antivirus, firewall, avoid suspicious attachments.

Exam wording: Ransomware encrypts the files in a computer, and the hacker then demands a ransom for decryption.

Book case (WannaCry, 2017): files locked, ransom US$300 in Bitcoin, doubled after 3 days, files deleted after 7 days. It spread like a worm using a stolen tool against a Windows vulnerability; Microsoft had already released a patch but many users had not updated. Lesson: update the OS regularly, use a firewall and antivirus, back up files regularly. If attacked: report to the police rather than pay (DSE 2019 1A Q38).
cards.zh:
比喻：小偷把你的柜子上锁，再说“付钱才给钥匙”。

运作：

  1. 经附件或未修补漏洞入侵。
  2. 加密 (encrypt) 文件，变得无法读取。
  3. 要求付赎金（常用 Bitcoin）换解密钥匙。
  4. 逾期加价或删除文件。

例：WannaCry (2017) 利用从美国 NSA 偷来的 Eternal Blue，攻击未更新的 Windows 漏洞，像 worm 般扩散。

中招时：不要付款；断网；报警；用备份还原。预防：定期离线备份、更新系统、防毒、防火墙、不开可疑附件。

考试写法：Ransomware encrypts the files in a computer, and the hacker then demands a ransom for decryption.

课本个案（WannaCry，2017）：文件被锁，勒索 300 美元比特币，3 天后加倍，7 天后删除文件。它像蠕虫一样利用 Windows 漏洞传播；微软早已推出修补程式，但很多人没更新。教训：定期更新系统、用防火墙和防毒、定期备份。中招时应报警，不要付赎金。

ex.q: Ken's files become unreadable and a message demands HK$3000 in Bitcoin. Give TWO actions and ONE preventive measure.
ex.a:
1. Disconnect the PC from the network (stop the spread).
2. Report to the police; restore from backup (do not pay).
3. Prevention: keep regular offline backups / update OS and antivirus.
ex.az: 断网、报警、备份还原；预防：定期离线备份、更新。

ex.q: Why should the backup be offline (e.g. an unplugged hard disk)?
ex.a:
1. Ransomware encrypts every file it can reach.
2. A backup drive that stays connected (or a synced folder) can be encrypted too.
3. An offline copy cannot be reached, so it survives.
ex.az: 连线中的备份也会被加密，离线备份才安全。

ex.q: A student writes: 'Pay the ransom quickly, then the problem is solved.' Why is this wrong?
ex.a:
1. There is no guarantee the hacker will send the key.
2. Paying funds crime and marks you as a target that pays.
3. Correct answer: isolate, report, restore from backup.
ex.az: 常见错误：付款就解决。付款不保证解密，还资助罪案。

frames.en: report.docx and photo.jpg can be opened.
frames.zh: 文件正常。

frames.en: Ransomware encrypts them: report.docx.locked, photo.jpg.locked.
frames.zh: 文件被加密。

frames.en: 'Pay 0.1 BTC in 72 hours for the key.'
frames.zh: 勒索讯息。

frames.en: Disconnect, report to police, restore from offline backup.
frames.zh: 断网、报警、用离线备份还原。

cards.en:
Analogy: germs enter the body through the mouth, nose, cuts. Malware also has 'entrances'.

Four channels (textbook):

  1. Dynamic web pages and client-side scripts: a script runs in your browser when you visit a hacked site.
  2. Communication software and email: infected attachments/links, often sent to all contacts.
  3. Freeware and shareware: free downloads bundled with malware.
  4. Storage devices: USB drives, CDs, memory cards.
ChannelMatching prevention
Web scriptsUpdate browser, block unknown scripts
Email/IMDon't open suspicious attachments/links
FreewareDownload from official sources
USBScan removable media, disable autorun

Exam wording: name the channel, then the matching prevention.

Static vs dynamic pages (book TIP): a static web page is all HTML with few interactive elements. A dynamic web page also contains client-side scripts (e.g. VBScript, JavaScript) run by the browser, e.g. to check input instantly. Malicious scripts in dynamic pages can open many pop-ups, download malware, or exhaust computer resources and paralyse the system.
cards.zh:
比喻：细菌经口、鼻、伤口入身体，恶意软件也有“入口”。

四种途径：

  1. 动态网页及客户端脚本 (client-side scripts)：浏览被入侵网站时执行。
  2. 通讯软件及电邮：附件/连结，常自动发给全部联络人。
  3. 免费及共享软件 (freeware/shareware)：捆绑恶意程式。
  4. 储存装置：USB、光碟、记忆卡。
途径对应预防
网页脚本更新浏览器、封锁不明脚本
电邮/通讯不开可疑附件/连结
免费软件官方来源下载
USB扫描外置装置、停用 autorun

考试写法：写出途径，再写对应的预防方法。

静态与动态网页（课本 TIP）：静态网页全是 HTML，互动元素少。动态网页还有由浏览器执行的客户端脚本（如 VBScript、JavaScript），例如即时检查输入。恶意脚本可弹出大量广告、下载恶意软件，或耗尽电脑资源令系统瘫痪。

ex.q: Suggest one spreading channel and its matching prevention for a school computer room.
ex.a:
1. Channel: students plug in USB drives carrying malware.
2. Prevention: antivirus automatically scans removable storage / disable autorun.
ex.az: USB → 自动扫描外置装置。

ex.q: Classify: (a) a cracked game from a forum (b) a WhatsApp link (c) a pop-up script on a hacked news site.
ex.a:
(a) freeware/shareware download
(b) communication software
(c) dynamic web page / client-side script
ex.az: (a) 免费软件 (b) 通讯软件 (c) 客户端脚本。

ex.q: Q: 'Malware spreads by email. Suggest a prevention.' A student answers: 'Install a firewall.' Why may this lose marks?
ex.a:
1. The prevention must match the channel.
2. A better match: do not open attachments/links from unknown senders; enable spam filtering; scan attachments.
3. A firewall alone does not stop a user opening an attachment.
ex.az: 常见错误：预防方法与途径不配对。电邮应答：不开不明附件、垃圾邮件过滤、扫描附件。

ex.q: Why can merely visiting a web page infect a computer, but opening a plain .txt file cannot run anything?
ex.a: A dynamic page has client-side scripts (JavaScript/VBScript) that the browser runs; a text file has no executable code.
ex.az: 动态网页有浏览器会执行的脚本；文本文件没有可执行代码。

cards.en:
Why it matters: exam questions often ask 'state the threat'. Learn this list.

  • Unauthorised access to the system or information.
  • Information locked, modified, destroyed or stolen.
  • Ransom demanded to decrypt or get back information.
  • Computer and network resources exhausted → system paralysed.
  • Device remotely controlled or running instructions from non-users (e.g. a zombie in a botnet).

For organisations: money loss, leaked customer data, legal liability, damaged reputation.

Exam wording: match each malware to its threat: ransomware → ransom; worm → resources exhausted; Trojan → remote control; spyware → data stolen.
cards.zh:
为什么重要：考试常问“写出威胁”，要背这表。

  • 他人未经授权存取系统或资料。
  • 资料被锁住、修改、破坏或偷取。
  • 被勒索赎金。
  • 电脑及网络资源耗尽 → 系统瘫痪。
  • 设备被遥控或执行非用户的指令（如 botnet 中的 zombie）。

对机构：金钱损失、客户资料外泄、法律责任、声誉受损。

考试写法：配对：ransomware → 赎金；worm → 资源耗尽；Trojan → 遥控；spyware → 资料被偷。

ex.q: Match: (a) ransomware (b) worm (c) Trojan with a threat.
ex.a:
(a) ransom demanded to decrypt information
(b) exhausted network resources, system paralysed
(c) device remotely controlled via a backdoor
ex.az: 勒索→赎金；蠕虫→耗尽资源；木马→遥控。

ex.q: An online shop's customer database is copied by malware. Give TWO consequences for the shop.
ex.a:
1. Customers' personal data leaked → legal liability (privacy law).
2. Damaged reputation → customers leave → financial loss.
ex.az: 法律责任、声誉受损、金钱损失。

ex.q: A student answers 'The computer becomes bad.' for 'State one threat of malware'. Improve it.
ex.a:
1. 'Becomes bad' is too vague for marks.
2. Use precise wording, e.g. 'Information may be stolen or destroyed' or 'resources are exhausted so the system is paralysed'.
ex.az: 常见错误：答案太含糊。要用课本用语。

cards.en:
Analogy: you pass notes to a friend through a classmate. The classmate reads every note and can change the words. Neither of you knows.

How it works:

  1. The hacker sits between sender and receiver.
  2. He makes a separate connection with each side; each thinks it talks directly to the other.
  3. He can read data (e.g. credit card number), tamper with it, or redirect links to malicious websites.

Evil twin attack (common MITM): the hacker sets up a free Wi-Fi with no password and a name like a real shop's. Everyone who connects sends traffic through him.

Defences: HTTPS (SSL/TLS) and check certificates; VPN on public Wi-Fi; avoid unknown open hotspots.

Exam wording: A MITM attack is a hacker attack between the normal sender and receiver, intercepting or tampering with the communication between the two parties.

Book Fig. 5.2, four things the middle man can do: eavesdropping (read and pass on unchanged), alteration (change 'I love ICT' to 'I hate ICT'), fabrication (send a fake message the sender never wrote), interception (stop the message from arriving). Because the victim's requests are still answered normally, interception is hard to detect.
cards.zh:
比喻：你经同学传纸条给朋友，同学偷看每张纸条，还可改字，你们都不知道。

运作：

  1. 黑客介入寄件人与收件人之间。
  2. 分别与两方连线，双方以为直接通讯。
  3. 可偷看资料（如信用卡号）、篡改内容、把连结导向恶意网站。

Evil twin attack（雙面惡魔攻擊）：黑客设无密码免费 Wi-Fi，名称仿真店铺，连上的人流量都经过他。

防范：HTTPS 并检查证书；公共 Wi-Fi 用 VPN；避免陌生开放热点。

考试写法：A MITM attack is a hacker attack between the normal sender and receiver, intercepting or tampering with the communication between the two parties.

课本图 5.2，中间人可做四件事：窃听（看了照传）、篡改（把 I love ICT 改成 I hate ICT）、伪造（发出发送者没写过的讯息）、拦截（令讯息到不了）。因为受害者的请求仍正常得到回应，所以很难察觉。

ex.q: In a café there are two Wi-Fi networks: 'CafeABC' (password on menu) and 'CafeABC_Free' (no password). Why is the second risky?
ex.a:
1. It may be an evil twin set up by a hacker.
2. All traffic passes through the hacker's access point.
3. He can intercept or tamper with data (MITM), e.g. capture login details.
ex.az: 可能是 evil twin，流量经黑客 AP，可截取篡改。

ex.q: A user sends 'Pay $100 to account 123'. The bank receives 'Pay $100 to account 999'. What happened?
ex.a:
1. A hacker between the two parties intercepted the message.
2. He tampered with the account number before forwarding it.
3. This is a MITM attack. HTTPS/encryption with integrity checking would stop it.
ex.az: 中间人篡改了户口号码，用 HTTPS 可防止。

ex.q: A student writes: 'MITM attack makes the server unable to provide services.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. That is a DoS attack.
2. MITM is about intercepting or tampering with communication between two parties, while both still think the connection works normally.
ex.az: 常见错误：混淆 MITM 与 DoS。MITM 是截取/篡改通讯。

ex.q: The receiver gets 'I hate ICT' though the sender wrote 'I love ICT'. Which MITM action?
ex.a: Alteration: the content was changed in transit.
ex.az: 篡改：内容在传送中被改。

frames.en: The user talks directly to the bank website through the real router.
frames.zh: 正常：用户经真路由器连银行。

frames.en: The hacker sets up 'CafeABC_Free' with no password. The user connects.
frames.zh: 黑客设免费假热点，用户连上。

frames.en: All data goes through the hacker. He copies the login password.
frames.zh: 所有数据经黑客，他复制密码。

frames.en: He changes the reply, e.g. a link now points to a fake site.
frames.zh: 他篡改回覆，连结指向假网站。

frames.en: With HTTPS + VPN, the hacker sees only encrypted data.
frames.zh: 用 HTTPS + VPN，黑客只见加密数据。

cards.en:
Analogy: a shop can serve 50 customers at a time. 10,000 fake customers rush in and block the door. Real customers cannot get in.

DoS: the hacker floods the target server with huge numbers of requests. Its bandwidth, CPU or memory runs out, so normal users cannot connect.

DDoS (Distributed DoS):

  1. The hacker infects many computers → zombie computers (together: a botnet). Owners usually don't know.
  2. He sends one command.
  3. All zombies send requests to the target at the same time from many places.

DDoS is harder to block because traffic comes from many different IP addresses.

Defences: firewall/traffic filtering, more bandwidth, DDoS protection services, keep your own PC clean so it is not a zombie.

Exam wording: A DoS attack refers to the attempts of hackers to make the target server unable to provide services to users. In a DDoS attack, hackers use numerous hacked computers as zombie computers, remotely controlled to send requests to the target.
cards.zh:
比喻：店铺同时只能招呼 50 人，一万个假客人涌入堵门，真客人进不了。

DoS：黑客以海量请求轰炸目标伺服器，耗尽频宽、CPU 或记忆体，正常用户无法连线。

DDoS：

  1. 黑客感染大量电脑 → 殭尸电脑 (zombie computers)，合称 botnet，主人通常不知情。
  2. 发出一个指令。
  3. 所有 zombie 同时从各地向目标发请求。

来源 IP 众多，更难阻挡。防范：防火墙/流量过滤、增加频宽、DDoS 防护服务、保持电脑干净免成 zombie。

考试写法：A DoS attack refers to the attempts of hackers to make the target server unable to provide services to users. In a DDoS attack, hackers use numerous hacked computers as zombie computers, remotely controlled to send requests to the target.

ex.q: A ticketing site goes down at 10:00 when tickets go on sale. Logs show millions of requests from 50,000 IP addresses. Identify the attack and explain 'zombie computer'.
ex.a:
1. Many IPs at once, server cannot serve → DDoS.
2. A zombie computer is a hacked computer remotely controlled by the hacker, without the owner knowing, to send requests to the target.
ex.az: 大量 IP → DDoS；zombie＝被遥控的电脑。

ex.q: A server can handle 2,000 requests/second. A botnet has 5,000 zombies, each sending 2 requests/second. Can normal users get in?
ex.a:
1. Attack traffic = 5,000 × 2 = 10,000 requests/s.
2. 10,000 > 2,000 capacity → server is overloaded.
3. Normal users' requests are dropped → service denied.
ex.az: 攻击流量 10,000/秒 > 容量 2,000/秒，正常用户无法连线。

ex.q: A student writes: 'To stop a DDoS attack, just block the attacker's IP address.' Why is this not enough?
ex.a:
1. In DDoS the requests come from thousands of zombie IPs, not one.
2. Blocking one IP hardly reduces the traffic, and zombie IPs belong to innocent users.
3. Need traffic filtering / DDoS protection service / more bandwidth.
ex.az: 常见错误：封一个 IP 就够。DDoS 来自大量 zombie IP，要用流量过滤或防护服务。

frames.en: Users send a few requests; the server replies quickly.
frames.zh: 正常：伺服器快速回应。

frames.en: The hacker infects many PCs; they become zombies.
frames.zh: 黑客感染电脑成 zombie。

frames.en: The hacker sends one command: 'attack ticket server now'.
frames.zh: 黑客发出攻击指令。

frames.en: All zombies send requests at once from different IPs.
frames.zh: 所有 zombie 同时从不同 IP 发请求。

frames.en: Resources are used up. Normal users get no reply.
frames.zh: 资源耗尽，正常用户无回应。

cards.en:
Analogy: police keep a book of wanted criminals' fingerprints. Antivirus keeps a book of malware 'fingerprints' called virus signatures.

How it works:

  1. Scan a file.
  2. Compare it with the virus signatures in the virus database.
  3. Match found → isolate the file (quarantine) from other files.
  4. Repair or delete it.

Virus signature = a unique pattern of code that identifies a known malware.

New malware appears every day, so enable automatic update. An old database cannot detect new malware.

Good habits: real-time protection on, regular full scans, scan downloads and USB drives.

Exam wording: Antivirus software scans the information in a computer and isolates infected files. It compares files with the virus signatures in the virus database. Users should enable automatic update to keep the database up to date.
cards.zh:
比喻：警察有通缉犯指纹册；防毒软件有恶意软件“指纹”册，叫病毒识别码 (virus signatures)。

运作：

  1. 扫描文件。
  2. 与病毒数据库的识别码比对。
  3. 吻合 → 隔离 (isolate/quarantine)。
  4. 修复或删除。

Virus signature＝识别已知恶意软件的独特程式码模式。

新恶意软件每天出现，要启用自动更新；旧数据库侦测不到新病毒。好习惯：实时保护、定期全机扫描、扫描下载和 USB。

考试写法：Antivirus software scans the information in a computer and isolates infected files. It compares files with the virus signatures in the virus database. Users should enable automatic update to keep the database up to date.

ex.q: A new virus appears today. Paul's antivirus was last updated 6 months ago. Will it detect the virus?
ex.a:
1. Detection compares files with signatures in the database.
2. The new virus's signature is not in Paul's old database.
3. So probably not detected. He should enable automatic updates.
ex.az: 数据库无新病毒码 → 侦测不到；要自动更新。

ex.q: Database signatures: A1F3, 9C2E, 77B0. Files contain patterns: x.exe → 9C2E, y.exe → 5D11, z.doc → A1F3. Which are quarantined?
ex.a:
1. x.exe: 9C2E is in the database → quarantine.
2. y.exe: 5D11 not found → passes.
3. z.doc: A1F3 found → quarantine.
Answer: x.exe and z.doc.
ex.az: x.exe 和 z.doc 吻合，被隔离。

ex.q: A student writes: 'I have antivirus, so I don't need a firewall.' What is wrong?
ex.a:
1. Antivirus finds malware files on the computer.
2. A firewall filters network packets and blocks unauthorised access.
3. They do different jobs; use both.
ex.az: 常见错误：有防毒就不用防火墙。两者功能不同，要互补。

frames.en: The antivirus reads x.exe and extracts its code pattern 9C2E.
frames.zh: 扫描 x.exe，取出模式 9C2E。

frames.en: It compares 9C2E with the virus database.
frames.zh: 与病毒数据库比对。

frames.en: Match found. x.exe is moved to quarantine.
frames.zh: 吻合，隔离 x.exe。

frames.en: Automatic update downloads new signatures daily.
frames.zh: 自动更新下载新识别码。

cards.t: Detecting new malware and choosing security software
cards.tz: 侦测新恶意软件与选择保安软件
cards.en:
Plain idea: signatures only catch known malware, so good antivirus also watches what programs do.

  • Active function = real-time scanning in the background (new files from USB or downloads are scanned at once). Passive function = scheduled or on-demand full scans.
  • Unknown malware: detected by behaviour, e.g. a program trying to infect other files.
  • Many products use cloud computing, so they perform worse offline; scan while connected to the Internet (Consumer Council test, Activity 5.4).
  • Free products: mainly antivirus + anti-spyware, usually no firewall. Paid Internet Security Suites: add firewall, bank page protection, spam filtering, parental control.
  • Choose by: malware-detection performance, resource usage (disk space, memory), how often the virus database is updated.
  • Common products: AVG, Kaspersky, Avira (free versions give basic protection).

Exam wording: Antivirus software must be updated regularly so its virus signatures can identify the latest malware; a newly released virus may not be detected even by the latest software until its signature is added.
cards.zh:
简单说：病毒识别码只认得已知恶意软件，所以好的防毒软件也会观察程序的行为。

  • 主动功能＝背景即时扫描（USB、下载的新文件立即扫）。被动功能＝定时或按需全面扫描。
  • 未知恶意软件：靠行为判断，例如程序试图感染其他文件。
  • 很多产品用云端运算，离线时表现较差；扫描时应连接互联网。
  • 免费版：主要防毒＋防间谍软件，通常没防火墙。付费 Internet Security Suite：多了防火墙、网上银行保护、垃圾邮件过滤、家长监控。
  • 选择要看：侦测表现、资源用量（硬碟空间、记忆体）、病毒库更新。
  • 常见：AVG、Kaspersky、Avira。

考试写法：Antivirus software must be updated regularly so its virus signatures can identify the latest malware; a newly released virus may not be detected even by the latest software until its signature is added.

ex.q: Kate's laptop has the latest antivirus but a virus still got in. Why? (DSE 2012P)
ex.a: The virus is new; its signature is not yet in the virus database, so signature matching cannot find it.
ex.az: 病毒太新，病毒库还没有它的识别码。

ex.q: Give two reasons to update antivirus regularly. (DSE 2018 1B)
ex.a:
1. Get new virus signatures to detect the latest malware.
2. Get fixes and improvements to the scanning engine.
ex.az: 取得新病毒识别码；更新扫描引擎修补。

ex.q: 'A free antivirus also gives me a firewall, so I need nothing else.' True?
ex.a: Usually not. Free products mainly cover antivirus/anti-spyware; firewalls are usually in paid suites (though the OS has its own firewall).
ex.az: 通常不对，免费版一般没防火墙。

cards.en:
Analogy: a security guard at the school gate checks every visitor's ID against a list of rules, and also checks who leaves.

How it works:

  1. Every data packet (a small piece of network data) goes in or out.
  2. The firewall checks its IP address, type, port and other info.
  3. It compares them with defined rules.
  4. Allow or block. If blocked, the user is warned; the user may add exceptions.

A port is a number that says which service a packet is for (e.g. 443 = HTTPS, 23 = Telnet).

Note: a firewall does not remove malware already on the PC; that is antivirus's job.

Exam wording: A firewall filters incoming and outgoing data packets, blocks malicious packets, prevents unauthorised access, and stops the computer from sending malicious packets. It checks the IP address, type and port of each packet against defined rules.
cards.zh:
比喻：校门保安按规则检查每个访客，也检查谁离开。

运作：

  1. 每个数据封包 (data packet) 进出。
  2. 防火墙检查 IP address、类型、port 等。
  3. 与预设规则比对。
  4. 允许或阻挡；阻挡时警告用户，用户可加例外。

Port 是表示服务的号码（443 = HTTPS，23 = Telnet）。

注意：防火墙不会清除已在电脑内的恶意软件，那是防毒软件的工作。

考试写法：A firewall filters incoming and outgoing data packets, blocks malicious packets, prevents unauthorised access, and stops the computer from sending malicious packets. It checks the IP address, type and port of each packet against defined rules.

ex.q: Rules: block all incoming packets to port 23; allow port 443 from any IP. A packet arrives for port 23 from 8.8.8.8. Result?
ex.a:
1. Check destination port: 23.
2. Matches 'block incoming to port 23' (any source).
3. Blocked. A packet to port 443 would be allowed.
ex.az: 目的 port 23 → 阻挡。

ex.q: Rules (checked top to bottom, first match wins): R1 block source 203.0.113.5; R2 allow port 80; R3 block all. Packets: P1 from 203.0.113.5 to port 80; P2 from 198.51.100.7 to port 80; P3 from 198.51.100.7 to port 25.
ex.a:
1. P1: R1 matches first → blocked (even though port 80).
2. P2: R1 no, R2 yes → allowed.
3. P3: R1 no, R2 no, R3 → blocked.
ex.az: P1 阻挡（R1 先吻合）；P2 允许；P3 阻挡。

ex.q: A student writes: 'The firewall will delete the virus on my computer.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. A firewall only filters packets going in and out.
2. It cannot scan or remove files already infected.
3. Use antivirus to remove it; the firewall may stop the virus sending data out.
ex.az: 常见错误：防火墙不会删除病毒，要用防毒软件。

frames.en: R1: block source 203.0.113.5. R2: allow port 443 and 80. R3: block everything else.
frames.zh: 规则 R1–R3。

frames.en: From 198.51.100.7 to port 443 → R2 matches → allowed.
frames.zh: 封包 A 去 443 → 允许。

frames.en: From 203.0.113.5 to port 80 → R1 matches first → blocked, user warned.
frames.zh: 封包 B 来自黑名单 IP → 阻挡。

frames.en: From 198.51.100.7 to port 23 (Telnet) → only R3 matches → blocked.
frames.zh: 封包 C 去 port 23 → 阻挡。

frames.en: Malware on the PC tries to send data out to the hacker → blocked too.
frames.zh: 电脑上的恶意软件向外发送 → 也被阻挡。

cards.tz: 软件防火墙与硬件防火墙
cards.en:
Analogy: a software firewall is a lock on your own bedroom door. A hardware firewall is the guard at the building's main entrance.

Software firewallHardware firewall
WhatProgram installed on the computerPhysical device with the firewall program written into a chip
ProtectsA single deviceAll devices in the network
Cost / setupLower cost, easy to installHigh cost, needs expertise
PerformanceUses the PC's resourcesMore efficient and stable

Organisations often use both: hardware at the Internet gateway + software on each PC.

Exam wording: Software firewall: can only protect a single device, easier to install and lower cost. Hardware firewall: protects all devices in the network, more efficient and stable, but the cost is high.
cards.zh:
比喻：软件防火墙像自己睡房门锁；硬件防火墙像大厦大门保安。

软件防火墙硬件防火墙
是什么装在电脑的程式程式写入晶片的实体设备
保护单一设备整个网络
成本/安装成本低、易安装成本高、需专业
效能占用电脑资源更有效率、更稳定

机构常两者并用。

考试写法：Software firewall: can only protect a single device, easier to install and lower cost. Hardware firewall: protects all devices in the network, more efficient and stable, but the cost is high.

ex.q: A school with 400 PCs: recommend a firewall type.
ex.a:
1. Many devices on one network → hardware firewall at the Internet gateway protects all 400 centrally.
2. It is more efficient and stable.
3. Software firewalls on each PC add a second layer.
ex.az: 硬件防火墙集中保护全校，再加软件防火墙。

ex.q: A student uses a laptop at home and in cafés. Which firewall is suitable?
ex.a:
1. One device that moves between networks.
2. A software firewall goes with the laptop everywhere, low cost, easy to install.
ex.az: 单一流动设备 → 软件防火墙。

ex.q: A student writes: 'A hardware firewall is better in every way.' Why is this not a full answer?
ex.a:
1. Hardware firewalls have high cost and need expertise to set up.
2. They do not protect a laptop once it leaves the network.
3. Comparison answers need advantages and disadvantages.
ex.az: 常见错误：只写优点。硬件防火墙成本高、离开网络就保护不到。

cards.en:
Analogy: a gym. 1) Show your membership card at the door (who are you?). 2) Your plan lets you use the pool but not the sauna (what can you use?). 3) The system logs when you came and what you used (what did you do?).

Access control restricts who can log in to a system. It has three parts, AAA:

  1. Authentication: verify the user's identity (who can access?). E.g. username + password, fingerprint, 2FA.
  2. Authorisation: grant access rights to data (what can be accessed?). E.g. read only, read and write, full control.
  3. Accounting: monitor access records to ensure correct use (what was accessed?). E.g. login logs, change logs.

Order matters: authenticate first, then authorise, while accounting records everything.

Exam wording: Authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user. Authorisation is the process of granting users the access to data. Accounting is monitoring the user's access records in the system to ensure the correct use of data.
cards.zh:
比喻：健身室：①门口出示会员卡（你是谁？）②你的计划可用泳池不能用桑拿（可用什么？）③系统纪录你何时来、用了什么（做了什么？）。

存取控制限制谁可登入系统，分三部分 AAA：

  1. Authentication 认证：核实用户身份（谁可存取？），如用户名＋密码、指纹、2FA。
  2. Authorisation 授权：给予存取权限（可存取什么？），如唯读、读写、完全控制。
  3. Accounting 帐号管理：监察存取纪录（存取了什么？），如登入及修改纪录。

次序：先认证，再授权；accounting 全程纪录。

考试写法：Authentication is the process of verifying the identity of a user. Authorisation is the process of granting users the access to data. Accounting is monitoring the user's access records in the system to ensure the correct use of data.

ex.q: School intranet: (i) students log in with ID and password; (ii) students can only view marks, teachers can edit; (iii) the system records who changed marks. Name each.
ex.a:
(i) Authentication – verifying identity.
(ii) Authorisation – different access rights.
(iii) Accounting – access records.
ex.az: 认证、授权、帐号管理。

ex.q: A mark was wrongly changed last night. Which part of AAA helps find who did it, and how?
ex.a:
1. Accounting.
2. The access log records user ID, time and the change made.
3. The school checks the log entry for that mark.
ex.az: Accounting 纪录了谁、何时、改了什么。

ex.q: A student writes: 'Authorisation means entering the password.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. Entering a password checks who you are → that is authentication.
2. Authorisation decides what you may access after you are identified.
Tip: authentiCation = Confirm identity; authoriSation = permiSSion.
ex.az: 常见错误：混淆 authentication 和 authorisation。输入密码是认证；授权是决定可存取什么。

demo.title: AAA when a student opens the marks system

frames.en: Tom enters ID s001 + password. The server checks them. Identity confirmed.
frames.zh: Tom 输入帐号密码，伺服器核实身份。

frames.en: Tom's role is 'student' → read-only on marks. Edit button is hidden.
frames.zh: 角色＝学生 → 只可读取。

frames.en: Tom tries to change a mark → refused (no write right).
frames.zh: Tom 尝试修改 → 被拒。

frames.en: The log records: s001, 21:05, viewed marks; 21:06, edit attempt refused.

cards.en:
Analogy: the Internet is a busy public road. A VPN is a private tunnel through it: cars inside cannot be seen from outside.

How it works:

  1. The user installs a VPN application.
  2. It builds a tunnel (not a physical cable, made by tunnelling technology) to the VPN server.
  3. Every data packet is encrypted before leaving the device.
  4. The VPN server decrypts it and forwards it to the destination.

Hackers and even the ISP see only encrypted traffic; websites see the VPN server's IP, not the user's.

Applications:

  • Intranet VPN: link LANs of different branches into one private company intranet.
  • Remote access VPN: staff/students at home use internal resources (e.g. network drive).
  • Access WAN via VPN: protect data on public networks from hackers and the ISP.

Exam wording: A VPN establishes a tunnel between the user's device and the VPN server. The VPN application encrypts network data packets, which protects data transmitted on the Internet and prevents unauthorised access.

More from the book: VPNs commonly use IPSec (Internet Protocol Security) to set up the encrypted connection. Intranet VPN is also called site-to-site; remote access VPN is also called client-to-site. A VPN also hides the user's IP address (sites see the VPN server's IP and location). WAN via VPN: wider geographic reach and lower cost than a leased line; can access services without geographical restrictions. Disadvantage: slower connection speed.
cards.zh:
比喻：Internet 是繁忙公路，VPN 是公路里的私人隧道，外面看不见里面的车。

运作：

  1. 用户安装 VPN 程式。
  2. 与 VPN 伺服器建立隧道 (tunnel)（非实体线，用 tunnelling technology）。
  3. 封包离开设备前先加密。
  4. VPN 伺服器解密并转发到目的地。

黑客及 ISP 只见加密流量；网站只见 VPN 伺服器 IP。

应用：

  • Intranet VPN：连接各分行 LAN 成私有内联网。
  • Remote access VPN：在家存取内部资源（如网络磁碟）。
  • 经 VPN 存取 WAN：在公共网络防黑客及 ISP。

考试写法：A VPN establishes a tunnel between the user's device and the VPN server. The VPN application encrypts network data packets, which protects data transmitted on the Internet and prevents unauthorised access.

课本补充：VPN 常用 IPSec 建立加密连线。企业内联网 VPN 又叫 site-to-site；远端存取 VPN 又叫 client-to-site。VPN 也会隐藏用户 IP（网站只见 VPN 伺服器的 IP 和位置）。经 VPN 接入 WAN：地域覆盖更广、比专线（leased line）便宜。缺点：连线速度变慢。

ex.q: A teacher at home needs the school network drive. How does VPN help and why is it secure?
ex.a:
1. She connects with a remote access VPN client to the school VPN server.
2. A tunnel is created over the Internet; packets are encrypted.
3. She uses the drive as if in school; intercepted data cannot be read.
ex.az: 远程存取 VPN，隧道加密，截取也读不到。

ex.q: A company has offices in Hong Kong and Shenzhen. How can their LANs share files privately without renting a private line?
ex.a:
1. Use an intranet VPN.
2. VPN gateways at each office build an encrypted tunnel over the Internet.
3. The two LANs act like one private intranet at low cost.
ex.az: Intranet VPN 经 Internet 连接两地 LAN。

ex.q: A student writes: 'A VPN tunnel is a special cable laid between the user and the server.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. The tunnel is not physical.
2. It is a logical connection over the ordinary Internet, made by tunnelling technology and encryption.
3. Security comes from encryption, not from a separate cable.
ex.az: 常见错误：以为隧道是实体线。隧道是在 Internet 上以加密形成的逻辑连线。

ex.q: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of a VPN. (Checkpoint 5.5)
ex.a: Advantage: encrypts data / hides online identity / cheaper than a leased line. Disadvantage: reduces connection speed.
ex.az: 优点：加密／隐藏身份／比专线便宜；缺点：变慢。

frames.en: On café Wi-Fi, data to the school server is readable by a hacker on the same network.
frames.zh: 没有 VPN，黑客可读取数据。

frames.en: The VPN app authenticates and builds a tunnel to the school VPN server.
frames.zh: VPN 程式认证并建立隧道。

frames.en: Each packet is encrypted on the laptop: 'grades.xlsx' → '8f#Q!z…'.
frames.zh: 封包在手提电脑加密。

frames.en: The VPN server decrypts and passes the request to the network drive.
frames.zh: VPN 伺服器解密并转发。

frames.en: The reply returns through the same encrypted tunnel.
frames.zh: 回覆经同一加密隧道返回。

cards.en:
Analogy: Wi-Fi is like talking loudly in a room: anyone nearby can hear. Encryption turns your words into a secret code.

Three standards (oldest → newest):

StandardKey pointSecurity
WEP (Wired Equivalent Privacy)Oldest, easily crackedLow
WPA (Wi-Fi Protected Access)Uses TKIP (Temporal Key Integrity Protocol): the key keeps changingMedium
WPA2Advanced version of WPA, higher security standards, widely usedHigh

Order: WPA2 > WPA > WEP.

Editions: Personal (home, one shared password) and Enterprise (business, each user logs in with an own account through a server).

Also: strong Wi-Fi password, change the router's default admin password.

Exam wording: WPA uses the Temporal Key Integrity Protocol (TKIP), which encrypts transmission data with a constantly changing key. WPA2 is an advanced version of WPA which conforms to higher security standards.

Enrichment: WPA/WPA2-Personal uses pre-shared key (PSK) mode: everyone uses the same password, stored on each device; change it on the router and every user must re-enter it. WPA/WPA2-Enterprise: users give their own login credentials to an 802.1X authentication server; devices never know the actual password. Routers are set up by typing the router's IP address in a browser (SSID, login, encryption protocol, whitelist).
cards.zh:
比喻：Wi-Fi 像在房间大声说话，附近的人都听到；加密把话变成暗号。

标准重点安全度
WEP最旧、易破解低
WPA用 TKIP，密钥不断改变中
WPA2WPA 进阶版，更高保安标准，最普遍高

次序：WPA2 > WPA > WEP。

版本：Personal（家居，共用密码）；Enterprise（商业，每人用自己帐户经伺服器认证）。另外：强密码、更改路由器预设管理密码。

考试写法：WPA uses the Temporal Key Integrity Protocol (TKIP), which encrypts transmission data with a constantly changing key. WPA2 is an advanced version of WPA which conforms to higher security standards.

增润：WPA/WPA2-Personal 用预共用密钥（PSK）：大家用同一密码，存在各自装置；路由器改密码后所有人要重新输入。WPA/WPA2-Enterprise：用户以自己的登入资料经 802.1X 认证伺服器连线，装置不知道真正密码。在浏览器输入路由器 IP 地址即可设定 SSID、登入、加密协定、白名单。

ex.q: A company with 200 staff uses WEP with one shared password. Suggest improvements.
ex.a:
1. WEP is easily cracked → upgrade to WPA2.
2. Use the Enterprise edition: each staff logs in with an own account.
3. When someone leaves, disable that account; no need to change a shared password for everyone.
ex.az: 升级 WPA2-Enterprise，每人独立帐户。

ex.q: Why is a constantly changing key (TKIP) safer than a fixed key?
ex.a:
1. A hacker needs to capture a lot of data encrypted with the same key to crack it.
2. If the key keeps changing, each key protects only a little data.
3. Even if one key is cracked, it soon becomes useless.
ex.az: 密钥不断转换，每个密钥只保护少量数据，破解了也很快失效。

ex.q: A student ranks security as 'WEP > WPA > WPA2 because WEP is the most widely tested'. Correct it.
ex.a:
1. Correct order is WPA2 > WPA > WEP.
2. WEP is the oldest and easily cracked; WPA added TKIP; WPA2 meets higher standards.
ex.az: 常见错误：次序颠倒。正确是 WPA2 > WPA > WEP。

cards.t: Hide SSID and MAC address filtering
cards.tz: 隐藏 SSID 与 MAC 地址过滤
cards.en:
Analogy: hiding the SSID = taking the name sign off your shop door. MAC filtering = a guest list at the door: only listed guests enter, even if others know the password.

SSID (Service Set Identifier) = the Wi-Fi name you choose. Routers normally broadcast it so devices list it.

Hide SSID: turn off SSID broadcast → the network does not appear in searches; users must type the name manually.

MAC address = a unique hardware address of each network card (e.g. 3C:22:FB:10:4A:7E).

MAC address filtering: the access point keeps a whitelist of MAC addresses; only those devices may connect.

Limits: extra layers only, not a replacement for WPA2. Skilled hackers can detect hidden SSIDs or spoof (fake) a MAC address. Adding new devices is inconvenient.

Exam wording: Turning off the SSID broadcast hides the network name so it cannot be automatically searched by other devices. With MAC address filtering, the access point only allows devices with MAC addresses on the whitelist to use the Wi-Fi network.
cards.zh:
比喻：隐藏 SSID＝拆掉店门招牌；MAC 过滤＝门口宾客名单，名单外的人知道密码也不能进。

SSID＝自订 Wi-Fi 名称，路由器通常会广播。

隐藏 SSID：关闭广播 → 搜寻不到，要手动输入名称。

MAC address＝每张网卡独特的硬件地址。

MAC 地址过滤：AP 设白名单 (whitelist)，只有名单上的设备可连接。

限制：只是额外防线，不能代替 WPA2；高手可侦测隐藏 SSID 或伪造 (spoof) MAC；新增设备麻烦。

考试写法：Turning off the SSID broadcast hides the network name so it cannot be automatically searched by other devices. With MAC address filtering, the access point only allows devices with MAC addresses on the whitelist to use the Wi-Fi network.

ex.q: Whitelist: 00:00:00:00:00:AA, 00:00:00:00:00:BB. Devices …AA, …CC, …DD try with the correct password. Which succeed?
ex.a:
1. …AA is on the whitelist → connects.
2. …CC, …DD are not → rejected even with the right password.
Answer: only AA.
ex.az: 只有 AA 在白名单。

ex.q: A family hides its SSID. A guest wants to join. What must the guest do?
ex.a:
1. The network does not appear in the list.
2. The guest must type the SSID manually and enter the password.
3. If MAC filtering is also on, the owner must add the guest device's MAC to the whitelist.
ex.az: 手动输入 SSID 和密码；如有 MAC 过滤要加入白名单。
